subject: Honoring Sexual Assault Awareness Month
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Cranley Fedor for Ohio Committee
body:
Survivors need our support – this month, let’s recommit to the fight. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44405401/341443726/-1406512299?refcode=ea.fbd6e28e-d0c1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.fbd6e28e-d0c1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODc0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYmQ2ZTI4ZS1kMGMxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sw7yirxtX_oR2ffytMstSh-YxRw5izmNexLi906Qvlw=) | Friend,

If you didn’t already know, April is Sexual Assault Awareness Month. This month, we recognize the bravery of survivors everywhere, while recommitting ourselves to a world where all are free from the threat and impact of sexual violence. **[TAKE THE PLEDGE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44405402/341443727/1586456911?refcode=ea.fbd6e28e-d0c1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.fbd6e28e-d0c1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODc0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYmQ2ZTI4ZS1kMGMxLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sw7yirxtX_oR2ffytMstSh-YxRw5izmNexLi906Qvlw=&emci=ecae8f5d-bec1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=fbd6e28e-d0c1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=22604289)** This month, we renew our commitment to ensuring that every person can live a life free from sexual violence. We renew our commitment to standing shoulder to shoulder with survivors, holding perpetrators accountable, and dismantling a culture that is complicit in allowing acts of sexual violence to continue.

According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, nearly 1 in 5 women in America experiences a rape or attempted rape, and nearly 44 percent of women and about 25 percent of all men experience some form of sexual violence in their lifetime. The unfortunate reality is that people of every age, ability, race, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and religion suffer the pain and trauma of sexual assault.

My own, personal experience has informed my actions to this very day, from my staunch support for abortion access to my decades-long work with survivors of human trafficking. **I’m proud to champion these causes as a State Senator, and I hope to one day champion them as Ohio’s Lieutenant Governor.**

[**So, this Sexual Assault Awareness Month, can I ask you to recommit to the fight to end sexual violence in all forms and stop this rape culture! an Amazon warehouse—but we need to do more to support workers.

We need a more pro-union Senate that will pass legislation to protect
workers’ rights, increase wages, improve working conditions, and keep

firsthand what happens when corporations move overseas in search of
ever-lower wages. That’s why he views every policy decision through the
lens of “how does this improve the lives of Ohio workers and their
families?”

That’s the kind of Senator Ohio needs.

name: Charlie Kirk, TPUSA
subject: Tell Elon to bring free speech back to Twitter!
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.readactnews._ra-IOsrw)
---
Fellow American, For the first time since the last administration, we have an opportunity to fight back against Big Tech! **Elon Musk's recent announcement that he has become the largest shareholder at Twitter gives us a unique chance to rewrite the narrative on cancel culture. That's why I'm asking you to join me and thousands of other Americans in calling on Elon Musk to REINSTATE the Twitter accounts of TUCKER CARLSON, CHARLIE KIRK, THE BABYLON BEE, and thousands of other freedom-loving patriots who have been silenced by Big Tech!** [**Add your name to the growing list of free speech advocates who refuse to back down to cancel culture!**](http://trk.readactnews._mSSbDGE6IVbY7A)
---
[](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
A few weeks ago, I was locked out of my Twitter account for daring to state the undeniable fact that Dr. Rachel Levine, a transgender member of Joe Biden's administration, only "transitioned" to become a "woman" in 2011, but lived as a man for the first 54 years of his life. A week later, Twitter locked my account and demanded that I delete the "offending" tweet in order to regain access. ** _I'll never give them the satisfaction_.** Tucker Carlson's story is almost identical, as is the story of my friends at the Babylon Bee... and I'm sure we all remember the day when Twitter censored another particularly high-profile conservative voice from the platform last year. All of us have been silenced, but NONE of us will surrender to the woke speech police. And with the entry of Elon Musk into Twitter leadership, it looks like we may not have to. Elon has long been a champion of free speech, and if we can rally thousands of free speech-loving patriots like you, I know that we can get his attention.
---
[**Sign the Petition Now**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
The world's richest man now has a significant amount of influence over the world's largest virtual "public square" - and he's on the side of free speech for every American. Now, we need to urge him to _use_ that influence to restore the voices of prominent conservatives who have been unjustly censored simply for speaking the truth. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to strike a crushing blow against the radical Left, and their attempts to destroy, demoralize, and de-platform conservatives nationwide! [** _This petition will serve as the backbone for efforts by conservatives across our country to fight back against Big Tech. That's why I need you to tell Elon Musk that you want some of America's top conservative voices BACK on Twitter!_**](http://trk.readactnews._tGhEjxgUWww)
---
[**Sign the Petition Now**](http://trk.readactnews._LA)
---
If Twitter is allowed to censor some of the most prominent conservative voices with impunity, it's just a matter of time before they silence millions more. But if we stand together, we'll never be silenced! [**Stand with me, the Babylon Bee, Tucker Carlson, and many others in calling on Elon Musk to do the right thing and bring back freedom of speech to the public square!**](http://trk.readactnews.) Thank you for your support.
---
For America, Charlie Kirk Founder & CEOTurning Point USA

subject: Future generations are counting on your response
body:
Please take time right now to review and complete Hillsdale College’s RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6895%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=Nw0gcD2H63BgD%2bujpix8pw&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60967%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7yBuswl%2fQZZve75nGSCr%2bg&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, Can you do me a favor? Please take time right now to review and complete Hillsdale College’s [**RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey**.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60968%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bV19zMgvVTrZ0v6s7i6pEw&sysid=1) My name is Bill Gray, and I’m the associate vice president of national donor outreach at Hillsdale College. It’s my responsibility to invite like-minded conservatives (like you!) to support Hillsdale. **I don’t use the word “battle” lightly, but with the stakes so high one must be blunt.** It’s clear to me that we are in a fight for the future of our nation--a fight against progressives who are targeting our youngest citizens. These so-called “progressives” seek to undermine traditional patriotism and ultimately transform American government and society. _The New York Times’_ recent “1619 Project” is the prime example of this effort to inject into the minds of our youngest citizens a biased distortion of our nation’s history. If you haven’t heard, the “1619 Project” places the founding of America in 1619, when the first slave arrived in Jamestown, rather than in 1776 when the Declaration of Independence proclaimed that “all men are created equal” and endowed by God with “unalienable rights.” **“Our democracy’s founding ideals,” the “1619 Project” proclaims, “were false when they were written.”** Outrageous! _The New York Times’_ stated goal with the “1619 Project” is to influence the curricula of K-12 schools nationwide. They teach young people that slavery--not freedom--is and always will be the central and defining idea of the American experience, making our country irredeemable. This project has garnered universal acclaim from the news media. In fact, the lead essayist just won a Pulitzer Prize! There are even talks about making the “1619 Project” into a feature film. **Given popular and widespread efforts like these, we should not be surprised that there is a decreasing sense of patriotism among younger Americans --and an increasing tendency to embrace socialism and other liberty-destroying ideas.** Education has become a battleground, and reviving a proper understanding of American history and government, especially among younger citizens, must be our** _most urgent priority._** Hillsdale College is at the forefront of this effort. **We are actively engaging the Left on the battlefield of education. And I need your help to make this effort even more effective.** Hillsdale is America’s most powerful advocate for intelligent and informed patriotism--our best defense against the loss of our liberty and insidious beliefs like socialism. We do this on our Michigan campus, with an undergraduate and graduate student body of over 1,500, and through education that reaches and teaches millions of citizens each year on behalf of liberty. And in response to new efforts such as the media-driven “1619 Project” that seek to turn the next generation of citizens against the principles of the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution, Hillsdale must expand this critical work--especially in 2020. As I said before, to fight and win this battle, Hillsdale needs your help right away. The FIRST step I need you to take right now is to complete the **RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY! Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey**. This national project seeks to make it clear that people in your state and nationwide still revere our founding principles of liberty, and refuse to let them be corrupted by those who hold America in contempt. **As _The New York Times’_ efforts make clear, powerful forces vehemently oppose this view of America, and their assault on our glorious history is taking place before our very eyes. ** _Our ongoing response, rooted in genuine learning, and proven to reach millions of citizens, must be escalated as quickly as possible._ And if, upon completing your Battle Plan, you feel a strong connection to Hillsdale’s work, then I urge you to please consider including a generous tax-deductible gift in support of expanding these efforts on behalf of liberty. Based on the costs of Hillsdale’s multiple educational programs--which I will outline fo**r you shortly --it has been determined that to fully implement this [RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60969%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hL%2bUCkbE6M%2b4Ufc1MxDpDA&sysid=1)** for maximum impact, Hillsdale College must raise at least $1,016,700 within the next month. And unlike most colleges and universities that rely on federal funding and subsidies, EVERY PENNY of funding for Hillsdale’s educational outreach comes from the voluntary support of intelligent patriots like you. This is because Hillsdale College refuses EVEN ONE PENNY of state or federal taxpayer funding--even indirectly in the form of student grants or loans. That’s so important, I need to say it again--Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding! **In this way, Hillsdale remains truly independent, avoiding unconstitutional regulations that would violate the College’s educational mission.** Hillsdale has built national support from hundreds of thousands of citizens. These intelligent patriots know that liberty in America is in trouble thanks to progressive control of our schools and institutions. And these citizens are determined to preserve our liberty--as I believe you are. These supporters give what they can, when they can--gifts of $25 or $50 or more, sometimes much more ... because they understand that every dollar given goes to reaching and teaching millions of people--including our nation’s youth--with genuine learning about liberty and the Constitution. The gift you choose to give today will determine whether Hillsdale can activate each component of the **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60960%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ps1JzHwOLxshtqulGV1IZA&sysid=1)** And this entire plan is tied to Hillsdale’s proven programs and publications that are educating millions of Americans right now. Here are the key aspects of Hillsdale’s plan for your review and feedback: **BATTLE PLAN POINT #1: Identify the Critical Concerns of Everyday Americans** I mentioned that our network of supporters that is hundreds of thousands of patriots strong--such a broad base of support gives us invaluable public-opinion data on what Americans are MOST concerned about given the current state of our nation. We are always eager to add new perspectives (like yours) that can make our work the most relevant and timely possible. **Your participation today will allow Hillsdale to strengthen our educational outreach efforts by targeting them where they’re needed most, on the areas of concern that matter most to the American people.** You were selected to be part of this effort based on your record of involvement in causes that strengthen America, AND because of Hillsdale’s confidence that you will respond quickly and honestly, lending your voice to our efforts to restore the Constitution. I’m counting on and very much looking forward to your survey response! **BATTLE PLAN POINT #2: Counter Progressive Teaching in America’s Schools** In this section we dig deep into Hillsdale’s proven educational outreach, and give you a sense of how we lead important conversations surrounding America’s history and founding principles--AND ask what YOU think about these efforts. And make no mistake--Hillsdale is uniquely qualified to drive this effort. Did you know that Hillsdale is one of only a few American colleges and universities that requires each student, regardless of major, to complete a one-semester course on the Constitution? This fact has earned the support of so many Americans who did not attend the College, and who have never even set foot on our campus--they understand that what we teach in our classrooms radiates all over America. Is this important to you? In 2012, Hillsdale began offering online courses _free of charge_ , because we see it as an effective way promote intelligent patriotism and civic virtue. We market the courses on social media and online to reach large audiences, especially younger Americans. The response has been tremendous--over 2.3 million citizens have taken one or more of our online courses. Do you think this is an effective means of reaching and teaching millions of Americans on behalf of liberty? We even have an online course that directly counters _The New York Times’_ “1619 Project.” This free course is called **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** and presents an unbiased and complete account of America’s past. To me this is a great example of why these free courses are needed: They safeguard the country, through education, against the damage to liberty inflicted by the Left. And what do you think about sending a free monthly digest of liberty, to millions of people? This newsletter is called _Imprimis_ , and it features speeches delivered at Hillsdale events by prominent scholars, journalists, and policymakers, focused on political, economic, historic, and cultural topics from a constitutional viewpoint. _Imprimis_ is America’s most widely-circulated publication in support of liberty, reaching more households and businesses than either the _Wall Street Journal_ or the “fake news” _New York Times_. Issues covering topics such as “Rediscovering the Wisdom of American History” and “Shall We Defend our Common History?” set _Imprimis_ apart. The publication is as a powerful counterbalance to the biased media outlets that pursue narrow, ideologically driven distortions of history. (If you’re not yet an _Imprimis_ subscriber, we’ll be happy to sign you up as soon as we hear from you.) **BATTLE PLAN POINT #3: Restore Excellence to K-12 Schools** In this section we explore how Hillsdale College is reshaping American K-12 education, especially through our Barney Charter School Initiative, which helps launch and guide classical K-12 charter schools nationwide, teaching thousands of K-12 students. These schools all have a strong civics curriculum. The curriculum provides young Americans with a solid grounding in our nation’s history, our limited constitutional government, and economics. In doing so, Hillsdale provides communities with a practical model of how schools can best serve students and the country. **Sustained by our supporters, Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative has assisted in the founding of more than 20 classical K-12 charter schools in 11 states, with approximately 12,000 students enrolled. And more of these K-12 schools are opening each year.** Do you support this effort to set a new standard for K-12 education and give young Americans a proper education? Hillsdale also launched a new initiative to send pocket Constitutions to thousands of elementary and junior high schools. We ship them with a promise to send as many pocket Constitutions as their schools need. **The response has been astounding.** We’ve now sent out more than 500,000 pocket Constitutions across the country, and we receive more requests every week. Does this effort to restore the Constitution to K-12 schools sound like a good idea to you? As you select your answers, I believe you will find that Hillsdale’s educational outreach is a powerful way to confront and ultimately overcome the progressive forces that seek to instill in young people the ruinous idea that America stands for slavery, not freedom. I know you love this country, and I hope you will partner with Hillsdale in defending America through education--education aimed at citizens of all ages nationwide. The first step is getting your thoughts on our **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60960%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ps1JzHwOLxshtqulGV1IZA&sysid=1)**
With your response you will represent your state as part of a major sampling of citizen opinion that can help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views and concerns of mainstream Americans--views that we can make available to policymakers and opinion leaders when we discuss the Left’s agenda, and use to strengthen our educational outreach efforts. What Hillsdale needs now is YOU--your thoughtful input on the work we’re doing, and your generous support to expand our work. **So please complete the[Battle Plan Survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60961%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JZ9mn2m5CJGtqFnVGqdiBg&sysid=1) today.** When you give to Hillsdale and share your opinions, you will join a dedicated and growing team of intelligent patriots, who always step up when the time comes to defend America against the progressives’ attack on American history and liberty. Thank you for your commitment to liberty in America. Warm regards,
Bill Gray
Assoc. Vice President of National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 **P.S**. We are in a battle for the future of America, because the Left is determined to transform our country ... by fundamentally changing how history is taught to young people. Education is the battlefield, and Hillsdale College urgently needs you standing with us to support and sustain our efforts. With your help, we can continue to reach and teach millions of citizens of all ages, especially the youngest Americans, with the principles of liberty underlying the Constitution. Please complete **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY! Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60962%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2449yrqxshSA5UAV1IGmQg&sysid=1)** to shape Hillsdale College’s defense of America against the progressive assault on history. Your response is needed within five days so we can finalize plans to expand our educational outreach on behalf of liberty.
---
_107 S West St. #826, Alexandria VA 22314_
_[Unsubscribe](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/OptOut.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6895%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=Nw0gcD2H63BgD%2bujpix8pw&sysid=1)_

| Dear Reader, This is troubling. Have you heard of COP26? Almost nobody has. Amid the distractions caused by lingering health issues, conflicts overseas, shortages, and inflation... Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen recently took the stage at COP26 in Glasgow, Scotland to address some of the world's most powerful people, including:
* S. President, Joe Biden...
* British Prime Minister, Boris Johnson...
* Canadian Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau...
* French President Emmanuel Macron...
* ... and many more...

From the stage, Yellen called for world leaders to commit to a $150 trillion 'global transition' of our economy. Since then, Bank of America has signed the accord, along with 131 countries, 234 cities, and 695 of the world's biggest companies. Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk have invested in this 'transformation' as well. What is it that Yellen, Biden, Trudeau, Bezos and Musk are pushing for? And what does it mean for your money? Investigative journalist and renowned economist, Nomi Prins has followed the money... And what she's found is startling. She says: **" While most Americans are distracted by mainstream media headlines calling for a stock market crash, I've found evidence that shows where the elites are spending $150 trillion to 'transform' the economy. Most Americans will be shocked when they see what happens next."** I had to know more, so I scheduled an interview for Nomi to go deeper into the details of this 'transformation.' She agreed to do the interview on one condition: she wanted to record it so she could get her message in front of as many Americans as possible before it's too late. [Go here to see how this ‘transformation’ will play out – and what it means for your money.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z863ran2ols8unb0kvpfhsfu9oid4p5hh8bt3ll0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdh68or7cdh2bs) Regards, Maria Bonaventura

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

"The
Constitution is kind of trash."

That's
what a guest-with an Ivy League degree-said recently on a
highly-rated daytime talk show.

You've
likely seen how "progressives" in the media, Big Tech, and
politics are amplifying attacks on our nation's principles of
limited government and personal liberty with outrageous
statements like "The Constitution is kind of trash."

And like
that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative
that our Constitution is flawed, outdated, and incapable of
dealing with the challenges of our time.

Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution-Alexander
Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison-gave you and me the perfect
guide to understanding its timeless principles: The Federalist
Papers.

Written
between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius,
The Federalist Papers were originally published as newspaper
editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution.

Thomas
Jefferson described them as "the best commentary on the
principles of government which ever was written."

And these
documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If
we're serious about solving the current issues in our country, we
shouldn't run from them. We should embrace them.

That's
why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course, "The
Federalist Papers," on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible
donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.

"The
Federalist Papers" course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for
viewing in your home or a small group.

You might
also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal
study. Hillsdale's faculty teach the course, and it will deepen
your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even
more.

These
DVDs also make a great gift for someone unfamiliar with our
nation's founding principles-maybe even a friend or family
member.

But
supplies are limited. So, be sure to get this special edition of
"The Federalist Papers" on DVD today. More than 200,000 people
have already taken this course, so this DVD box set won't last
long.

You can
use this secure link to receive your copy of "The Federalist
Papers" right now:

https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers

Warm
regards,

Bill
Gray, '01
Vice

Donor Outreach
Hillsdale
College

Our mission at the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE) is to reach and teach young Americans the timeless principles upon which American freedom and prosperity are based.

Our vision is to make the ideas of liberty--free markets, limited government, and individual liberty--familiar, credible, and compelling to the rising generation.

**We 're accomplishing this mission with FEE in the Classroom. In 2021, we taught over 21,000 students about the principles of liberty.**

[**_I 'm looking to teach 5,000 new students next month, but I need sponsors, _**_**Friend**_ _**. Will you donate $25, $50, $100, or any amount today?**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zg8cl2sc442bk3n4a8jun94e0ruqj24jkjvmb7jo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdh68or2cph2bs)

## HUGE Endorsement
---
Yesterday, the [Oklahoma Second Amendment Association](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7621709.5459.1.ebe7d86349e2151d5fafde1a4704e304) endorsed me over [James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7621709.5460.1.0e3bd4297be2e8c72a14f6d02bfa9f31) for the US Senate race! This is a massive group with tremendous influence throughout the state of Oklahoma. I am beyond honored to receive their support and unlike [James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7621709.5461.1.150a932eb7ffa561fe8acd558b3b90aa), I can guarantee that I will not have an **F rating** with [Gun Owners of America](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7621709.5462.1.6989ffd25be7254cc2c9a6a92d2dc0d6) when I serve in DC. This US Senate race is going to be VERY close. A recent poll was released by **Just Oklahoma Data** that surveyed 867 _likely_ Oklahoma Republican primary voters via text message: [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7621709.5463.1.211e64846fd382e126c55de15b468cc0) received 46.83%, [Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=7621709.5464.1.c433fc0305c01027d3f56ffae0022fd1) 35.87% and 17.3% were undecided. We have gained so much ground in such a short amount of time against a career Politician with the DC machine behind him. We have had **over 8000 individuals donate** to the campaign, **rallies with thousands** of Oklahomans in attendance and **national endorsements** from _Roger Stone_ , _Mike Lindell_ , _Sebastian Gorka_ , _OKGOP Chairman John Bennett_ and others. name: Deroy Murdock
subject: Future generations are counting on your response
body:
Can you do me a favor?
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zjm4khn3alekij5n3e0kgathocsick1via48pmb0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onhckq6fd1gmaq74dj6eorm9pr0e5p7fcli6ip31p9l6aq64djn6pi64odn6hqjeduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdn6dhmfclncoq61cr2cuobapbi46h22sh2s8i66pb0cdh6eo32c5h2bs)
This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zk6qn9d10juemdqkq5s7v62m9pougjf4dode705o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdh6eo32c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Can you do me a favor? Please take time right now to review and complete Hillsdale College’s [**RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey**.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z6osp9da33fupnfihvc5ml5q8hn9ski2sob8vc30_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdh6eo32c5h2bs) My name is Bill Gray, and I’m the associate vice president of national donor outreach at Hillsdale College. It’s my responsibility to invite like-minded conservatives (like you!) to support Hillsdale. **I don’t use the word “battle” lightly, but with the stakes so high one must be blunt.** It’s clear to me that we are in a fight for the future of our nation—a fight against progressives who are targeting our youngest citizens. These so-called “progressives” seek to undermine traditional patriotism and ultimately transform American government and society. _The New York Times’_ recent “1619 Project” is the prime example of this effort to inject into the minds of our youngest citizens a biased distortion of our nation’s history. If you haven’t heard, the “1619 Project” places the founding of America in 1619, when the first slave arrived in Jamestown, rather than in 1776 when the Declaration of Independence proclaimed that “all men are created equal” and endowed by God with “unalienable rights.” **“Our democracy’s founding ideals,” the “1619 Project” proclaims, “were false when they were written.”** Outrageous! _The New York Times’_ stated goal with the “1619 Project” is to influence the curricula of K-12 schools nationwide. They teach young people that slavery—not freedom—is and always will be the central and defining idea of the American experience, making our country irredeemable. This project has garnered universal acclaim from the news media. In fact, the lead essayist just won a Pulitzer Prize! There are even talks about making the “1619 Project” into a feature film. **Given popular and widespread efforts like these, we should not be surprised that there is a decreasing sense of patriotism among younger Americans—and an increasing tendency to embrace socialism and other liberty-destroying ideas.** Education has become a battleground, and reviving a proper understanding of American history and government, especially among younger citizens, must be our** _most urgent priority._** Hillsdale College is at the forefront of this effort. **We are actively engaging the Left on the battlefield of education. And I need your help to make this effort even more effective.** Hillsdale is America’s most powerful advocate for intelligent and informed patriotism—our best defense against the loss of our liberty and insidious beliefs like socialism. We do this on our Michigan campus, with an undergraduate and graduate student body of over 1,500, and through education that reaches and teaches millions of citizens each year on behalf of liberty. And in response to new efforts such as the media-driven “1619 Project” that seek to turn the next generation of citizens against the principles of the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution, Hillsdale must expand this critical work—especially in 2020. As I said before, to fight and win this battle, Hillsdale needs your help right away. The FIRST step I need you to take right now is to complete the **RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY! Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey**. This national project seeks to make it clear that people in your state and nationwide still revere our founding principles of liberty, and refuse to let them be corrupted by those who hold America in contempt. **As _The New York Times’_ efforts make clear, powerful forces vehemently oppose this view of America, and their assault on our glorious history is taking place before our very eyes. ** _Our ongoing response, rooted in genuine learning, and proven to reach millions of citizens, must be escalated as quickly as possible._ And if, upon completing your Battle Plan, you feel a strong connection to Hillsdale’s work, then I urge you to please consider including a generous tax-deductible gift in support of expanding these efforts on behalf of liberty. Based on the costs of Hillsdale’s multiple educational programs—which I will outline fo**r you shortly—it has been determined that to fully implement this[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zv6dksa8qu7rm9aqnpghfoms9i4l0v4iai00qpj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdh6eo32c5h2bs)** for maximum impact, Hillsdale College must raise at least $1,016,700 within the next month. And unlike most colleges and universities that rely on federal funding and subsidies, EVERY PENNY of funding for Hillsdale’s educational outreach comes from the voluntary support of intelligent patriots like you. This is because Hillsdale College refuses EVEN ONE PENNY of state or federal taxpayer funding—even indirectly in the form of student grants or loans. That’s so important, I need to say it again—Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding! **In this way, Hillsdale remains truly independent, avoiding unconstitutional regulations that would violate the College’s educational mission.** Hillsdale has built national support from hundreds of thousands of citizens. These intelligent patriots know that liberty in America is in trouble thanks to progressive control of our schools and institutions. And these citizens are determined to preserve our liberty—as I believe you are. These supporters give what they can, when they can—gifts of $25 or $50 or more, sometimes much more ... because they understand that every dollar given goes to reaching and teaching millions of people—including our nation’s youth—with genuine learning about liberty and the Constitution. The gift you choose to give today will determine whether Hillsdale can activate each component of the **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zl0l0ijfjobdf4imbn78mq98hh1ettf5kum6jgu8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdh6eo32c5h2bs)** And this entire plan is tied to Hillsdale’s proven programs and publications that are educating millions of Americans right now. Here are the key aspects of Hillsdale’s plan for your review and feedback: **BATTLE PLAN POINT #1: Identify the Critical Concerns of Everyday Americans** I mentioned that our network of supporters that is hundreds of thousands of patriots strong—such a broad base of support gives us invaluable public-opinion data on what Americans are MOST concerned about given the current state of our nation. We are always eager to add new perspectives (like yours) that can make our work the most relevant and timely possible. **Your participation today will allow Hillsdale to strengthen our educational outreach efforts by targeting them where they’re needed most, on the areas of concern that matter most to the American people.** You were selected to be part of this effort based on your record of involvement in causes that strengthen America, AND because of Hillsdale’s confidence that you will respond quickly and honestly, lending your voice to our efforts to restore the Constitution. I’m counting on and very much looking forward to your survey response! **BATTLE PLAN POINT #2: Counter Progressive Teaching in America’s Schools** In this section we dig deep into Hillsdale’s proven educational outreach, and give you a sense of how we lead important conversations surrounding America’s history and founding principles—AND ask what YOU think about these efforts. And make no mistake—Hillsdale is uniquely qualified to drive this effort. Did you know that Hillsdale is one of only a few American colleges and universities that requires each student, regardless of major, to complete a one-semester course on the Constitution? This fact has earned the support of so many Americans who did not attend the College, and who have never even set foot on our campus—they understand that what we teach in our classrooms radiates all over America. Is this important to you? In 2012, Hillsdale began offering online courses _free of charge_ , because we see it as an effective way promote intelligent patriotism and civic virtue. We market the courses on social media and online to reach large audiences, especially younger Americans. The response has been tremendous—over 2.3 million citizens have taken one or more of our online courses. Do you think this is an effective means of reaching and teaching millions of Americans on behalf of liberty? We even have an online course that directly counters _The New York Times’_ “1619 Project.” This free course is called **“The Great American Story: A Land of Hope”** and presents an unbiased and complete account of America’s past. To me this is a great example of why these free courses are needed: They safeguard the country, through education, against the damage to liberty inflicted by the Left. And what do you think about sending a free monthly digest of liberty, to millions of people? This newsletter is called _Imprimis_ , and it features speeches delivered at Hillsdale events by prominent scholars, journalists, and policymakers, focused on political, economic, historic, and cultural topics from a constitutional viewpoint. _Imprimis_ is America’s most widely-circulated publication in support of liberty, reaching more households and businesses than either the _Wall Street Journal_ or the “fake news” _New York Times_. Issues covering topics such as “Rediscovering the Wisdom of American History” and “Shall We Defend our Common History?” set _Imprimis_ apart. The publication is as a powerful counterbalance to the biased media outlets that pursue narrow, ideologically driven distortions of history. (If you’re not yet an _Imprimis_ subscriber, we’ll be happy to sign you up as soon as we hear from you.) **BATTLE PLAN POINT #3: Restore Excellence to K-12 Schools** In this section we explore how Hillsdale College is reshaping American K-12 education, especially through our Barney Charter School Initiative, which helps launch and guide classical K-12 charter schools nationwide, teaching thousands of K-12 students. These schools all have a strong civics curriculum. The curriculum provides young Americans with a solid grounding in our nation’s history, our limited constitutional government, and economics. In doing so, Hillsdale provides communities with a practical model of how schools can best serve students and the country. **Sustained by our supporters, Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative has assisted in the founding of more than 20 classical K-12 charter schools in 11 states, with approximately 12,000 students enrolled. And more of these K-12 schools are opening each year.** Do you support this effort to set a new standard for K-12 education and give young Americans a proper education? Hillsdale also launched a new initiative to send pocket Constitutions to thousands of elementary and junior high schools. We ship them with a promise to send as many pocket Constitutions as their schools need. **The response has been astounding.** We’ve now sent out more than 500,000 pocket Constitutions across the country, and we receive more requests every week. Does this effort to restore the Constitution to K-12 schools sound like a good idea to you? As you select your answers, I believe you will find that Hillsdale’s educational outreach is a powerful way to confront and ultimately overcome the progressive forces that seek to instill in young people the ruinous idea that America stands for slavery, not freedom. I know you love this country, and I hope you will partner with Hillsdale in defending America through education—education aimed at citizens of all ages nationwide. The first step is getting your thoughts on our **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zv75r4th2f9nsak5p87lc6h1d30rr6d0649lklfo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdh6eo32c5h2bs)**
With your response you will represent your state as part of a major sampling of citizen opinion that can help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views and concerns of mainstream Americans—views that we can make available to policymakers and opinion leaders when we discuss the Left’s agenda, and use to strengthen our educational outreach efforts. What Hillsdale needs now is YOU—your thoughtful input on the work we’re doing, and your generous support to expand our work. **So please complete the[Battle Plan Survey](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zk8dvor5tkr69485e60e2pnmf4ll2l2bl4joruo8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdh6eo32c5h2bs) today.**
When you give to Hillsdale and share your opinions, you will join a dedicated and growing team of intelligent patriots, who always step up when the time comes to defend America against the progressives’ attack on American history and liberty. Thank you for your commitment to liberty in America. Warm regards,
Bill Gray
Assoc. Vice President of National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 **P.S**. We are in a battle for the future of America, because the Left is determined to transform our country ... by fundamentally changing how history is taught to young people. Education is the battlefield, and Hillsdale College urgently needs you standing with us to support and sustain our efforts. With your help, we can continue to reach and teach millions of citizens of all ages, especially the youngest Americans, with the principles of liberty underlying the Constitution. Please complete **[RECLAIM AMERICA’S HISTORY! Three-Point National Battle Plan Survey](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z981jgo0eo7je6k7oq3d2m7lt3b503bp3rbru07o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdh6eo32c5h2bs)** to shape Hillsdale College’s defense of America against the progressive assault on history. Your response is needed within five days so we can finalize plans to expand our educational outreach on behalf of liberty.
---
If dpwillis67@gmail.com should not be subscribed or if you need to change your subscription information for Deroy Murdock, [please use this preferences page](http://e.deroymurdock.com/prefs/9z2zukc6i67jj574gjgstoo2manb73su50h6res7afg).
625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

Geoff Diehl, Republican candidate for Governor, announced today that he will agree to participate in two pre-primary debates with any other Republican gubernatorial candidate who secures enough certified signatures and convention votes to appear on the September primary ballot along with him.
Diehl's campaign has consistently said that Diehl would participate in debates as soon as any other challengers paid their required convention fee, submitted more than 10,000 certified signatures, and secured more than 15% of the vote at the convention.
Diehl paid a required fee of $25,000 to participate in the MassGOP nominating convention in December 2021. The campaign has already secured pledges of far more than 15% of convention delegates in order to place Diehl's name on the primary ballot, and today the Secretary of State's office confirmed that Diehl has more than 10,000 certified signatures from voters, which were all collected by volunteers.
According to Diehl's campaign, Howie Carr and Jeff Kuhner have both agreed to each host one-hour debates on their respective radio shows in July or August, before the state primary election.

body: 96https://winred.kansansformarshall.com/marshall/title-42-email-fundrais ing?utm_source=sgrc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022april22hf Friend — This week marked another grim milestone in Joe Biden’s Border Crisis. We learned that last month there were more than 221,000 migrant encounters at the border — a new record. subject: The grades are in
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY REPUBLICAN ACCOUNTABILITY PROJECT, A PROJECT OF DEFENDING DEMOCRACY TOGETHER
body:
Trump and his enablers pretend to be conservative, but really they represent something different. Something dangerous.
|
---
Hi Friend, Bill Kristol here. I’d like to share with you why I’m helping lead the Republican Accountability Project after a career in Republican and conservative politics. I’ve seen a lot in my time in Washington. From positions in the Reagan and Bush administrations to co-founding The Weekly Standard, I’ve spent more than four decades trying to develop and implement conservative principles. **But when Donald Trump became the Republican nominee in 2016, the principles I had spent my career championing were thrown overboard. ** Trump and his enablers pretend to be conservative, but really they represent something different. Something dangerous. 147 Republicans in Congress voted against certifying the 2020 election results. They continue to deny that the January 6 insurrection really mattered. And their top priority is making sure there are no consequences for their actions. Holding them accountable has now become an important priority—not just for saving the Republican party, but for saving our democracy. RAP is committed to making sure no Republican escapes the choices they make. [**That’s why we created the** **GOP Democracy Report Card** ](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VVGyVx18ntwqW4877qZ6pdhrhW22vCbp4J9-GtN5wYXRD3q905V1-WJV7CgYrkW8c1M4-6rRjfyW4jH0MD12x-0fV6_q9w1WD1J3W1K2Z4k1jsJ2RW4Zrbdy6-SdhNW13qHSK37nGWXW89hTK53GXnJ0N8wp8L3dXrxTW3ts29Z4hj_gmN56Vf_43GxwKW2_9KDd8z8Cs8W2-d75G5h3nxgW7p7Ff78gzCy6W66CxK21KSj0mW53gtd62vT0rbW1sC7r84Sq6mNW1JnRVD61RwHBW9fSv548-xkGzW3dtmNm7CcHWGW3XWhQZ5GX2gwN72Tzh4y_FdQW9hBTxN4Nv7BzV_B8Cx7nVM3SW24v2t-7pyWvT3dvc1)to track every Republican legislator. It lets you see at a glance who chose to defend our democracy, and who chose not to. [**Take a look and see how your member ranks.**](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VVGyVx18ntwqW4877qZ6pdhrhW22vCbp4J9-GtN5wYXRD3q905V1-WJV7CgM3JVlKjTR6Zhh7YW2yD2Yr7Zz6tRW5nvQQM3JhMWpN2BVnpDvYBxpW24cBm44H4jLLW1L9pVp2gsl-MW7hvHjY2W4cKqN4WjHZVQnJhZW1g_jM63fH6q5VVX_658GnsGNW1PT_tL2_gk40W7qmKpg55Jft2N597Rf72qd4CW8H0jTM31dShyW23l2CH1PZ9r7W6Wgp3F7844nRW8qdVyp4JGTTmW7rBDCx5Wz77yN1Bw9qY6wc5-W4BVht69179XqW27NPvh7C8bCVW1kJ2vw1ZDKqdVt7PBc86scWfW9dx5hG5rd9MC3bf61)** ** I’m glad to have you with us as we hold everyone in the Republican Party accountable, and as we work to defend those who did the right thing. Bill Kristol Republican Accountability Project

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
---
**April 22, 2022
CONTACT: Rachel Tripp
202.738.9089**
---
| |
# Bill McSwain Urges Lawmakers to Pass Lifeline Scholarships
**West Chester, Pa.** **\--** Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, today urged lawmakers to swiftly pass Lifeline Scholarship legislation to rescue children across Pennsylvania who are trapped in underperforming schools:
---
|
> _**"****I’ve toured schools and I’ve spoken with parents and students—and the need to ensure children have access to the best possible education is immediate and critical. From Governor Wolf’s school shutdowns to underperforming or even dangerous schools, students across Pennsylvania have endured too much for too long. We can’t wait any longer. Students need rescue—they need a lifeline. The time to act is now. ****As Governor, ****I will advocate for school choice for every Pennsylvania family and child.”**_
---
| Currently pending before lawmakers, Lifeline Scholarships would offer scholarships to public school students who attend schools in the bottom 15 percent in terms of lowest performing schools. These scholarships could be used for approved educational expenses, including curriculum, tuition, and tutoring services.

McSwain previously signed the Education Freedom Pledge, which asserts in part that parents have the right “to take their children’s taxpayer-funded education dollars to the education providers of their choosing - whether it be a public, private, charter, or home school.”

McSwain continued:
---
|
> _**"As Governor, not only would I immediately sign Lifeline Scholarships into law, but I would also sign any legislation that prioritizes students over bureaucratic systems. This includes legislation that expands tax credit scholarships, legislation that establishes educational savings accounts, and legislation that ensures education funding follows the child to the school of his or her family’s choosing. ****For too long, politicians have prioritized systems over students. I will change the conversation, prioritize students over systems, and ensure Pennsylvania is a state that offers equal educational opportunity to every child, in every family, in every community across our Commonwealth."**_
---
|
---
| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming a prosecutor, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=bdcb331513&e=b1ec95759b)

Dear Fellow Conservative, Right now, America's biggest adversaries like China are working to surpass our nation's military capabilities. And critical problems exist in many areas of the world:
* Countries like Iran act deceitfully and use their military to bully other countries.
* Rogue states like North Korea and Syria pose direct threats to their regions and the security of the U.S.
* And countries like China and Russia have proven they will do whatever necessary to overturn the more freedom-seeking international order and move toward government control and state surveillance of citizens.

On top of all this, our country's military equipment-including planes, tanks, and ships-is decades-old and years past its useful service. With information like this, you would think our elected leaders would push to ensure a strong future for our nation's military. But some of them are actually looking to reduce America's defense spending. Apparently, they would rather prioritize issues like climate change. That's why I'm emailing you today. I'm told that you are a conservative who wants to ensure that our country remains a beacon of hope, opportunity, and liberty for all the world. And I understand that you are just as concerned as I am about the future of America's defense.

subject: Climate change is here, and I need your help to fight for justice.

body:
One day of recognition isn't enough for environmental justice
Happy Earth Day, Peter!

Growing up on the Olympic Peninsula, I've had the joy of growing up with forests and mountains and water as my backyard. It's a privilege I will never take for granted. I've also seen how vital these natural resources are to the members of our community, as various people rely on them for recreation, jobs, and their overall quality of life.

At the same time, all of us have witnessed the devastating impacts of climate change. We've had to weather the impact of forest fires, droughts, and flooding in our own backyard.

The science is clear: Climate change is real, and we have to act now so that our children and grandchildren will get to experience the beauty of our planet, just as we did.

**[I am committed to fighting to protect our planet every day of the year- not just on Earth Day but every day. Will you join me in the fight to combat the climate crisis? Add your name this Earth Day to support our fight for a greener, healthier America >>](https://act.myngp.com/el/uHhAg_X_6jh3puSwR9N3diqjsOb7aCrTAF9ucnclMSA=/-_MlbMvxV2ebBc7h2P5jrO_rdrt5zNf6tstEp3U5RHI=?ms=em22_220421_eday_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&refcode=em22_220421_eday_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&source=em22_220421_eday_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220421_eday_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})**

I've seen firsthand climate change's damage to our earth, especially regarding the impact it has had on coastal tribal communities. That's why protecting our environment has always been one of my top priorities.

I'm proud we secured $3.6 million in federal funding for three tribal relocation efforts in Western Washington. I'm proud to fight for legislation that supports our environment and our local economy, like The Wild Olympics Wilderness and Wild and Scenic Rivers Act and the Puget SOS Act. The Bipartisan Infrastructure Law I championed was a huge step forward, but we have to do more.

**Continuing my efforts towards climate justice is not something I can do alone, Peter.**

**[Can I count on your support? Please add your name next to mine to join the fight to defend our environment this Earth Day.](https://act.myngp.com/el/uHhAg_X_6jh3puSwR9N3diqjsOb7aCrTAF9ucnclMSA=/-_MlbMvxV2ebBc7h2P5jrO_rdrt5zNf6tstEp3U5RHI=?ms=em22_220421_eday_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&refcode=em22_220421_eday_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&source=em22_220421_eday_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220421_eday_adv_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})**

Growing up on the Olympic Peninsula, I've had the joy of growing up with forests and mountains and water as my backyard. It's a privilege I will never take for granted. I've also seen how vital these natural resources are to the members of our community, as various people rely on them for recreation, jobs, and their overall quality of life. At the same time, all of us have witnessed the devastating impacts of climate change. We've had to weather the impact of forest fires, droughts, and flooding in our own backyard. I like our chances going into this election, and it’s because of your amazing support that I believe we can win this. Now more than ever,**we must keep up the momentum.** [Please contribute to my campaign](https://heimlichforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93d2b220a5efc44f0b96119a2&id=b477b48b6a&e=544bb4cd89) today. * Multi-channel fundraising and voter outreach will continue all the way up to election day.
* We’re getting [excellent media coverage](https://heimlichforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93d2b220a5efc44f0b96119a2&id=31f15b309f&e=544bb4cd89) as I make clear how our pro-democracy platform sets me apart from incumbent Warren Davidson and other extremists who put our country at risk.
* Stay tuned for more events where I’ll be connecting with constituents. I hear from voters every day — Republicans, Democrats, Independents — who appreciate my embrace of America’s founding principles.

**Are you a Republican who stands with Ukraine against Russian aggression? ** Help me defeat Warren Davidson who has been named a member of the [“Pro-Russia-War-Crimes-Caucus”](https://heimlichforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93d2b220a5efc44f0b96119a2&id=724c241de9&e=544bb4cd89) for parrotting Vladimir Putin’s lines instead of standing up for the victims of Russian war crimes. **Are you a Democrat who worries about political extremism threatening our democracy?** You can vote for me in the primary! Thanks for helping me prevent Davidson from making it to the general election! All the best,

We have lots of exciting updates to share!

| Hi Peter, and happy Earth Day!

Today, we celebrate our planet, our only home.

We Wisconsinites are lucky to live among so much natural beauty, and future generations deserve to experience it too. This Earth Day, we _must_ recommit to protecting our environment by curbing pollution, expanding green energy initiatives, and investing in our future. Deb is committed to advocating for Wisconsin’s environment when she gets to Congress - she knows that nothing is more important than saving our planet for our children and theirs. When I was in high school, I experienced Snowmageddon. While living on the West Coast, I experienced droughts and wildfires. While living in Brazil, I saw first hand the deterioration of the Amazon and its effects on the environment. There is no question about whether the climate is changing. The only question is, what are we going to do about it? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/victoria-for-congress?refcode=earth]
The climate crisis is accelerating, and we need an immediate and bold climate policy to preserve our communities and ensure a safe world with clean air and water for our children. On Earth Day, I will continue to uplift the moral and ethical right that all people have to a clean, healthy, and sustainable earth.
I am running as Representative for Virginia’s 8th to ensure that the United States upholds its moral responsibility to perserving our planet. By prioritizing climate policy, it will not only strengthen the health of our environment, but also our economy when we ensure workers and communities receive the support, social protection, and investments they need to work and thrive in a zero-carbon future. I will also advocate for Virginia’s 8th by fighting for resources to subsidize retrofitting of the thousands of historic buildings to preserve the beauty of our district by incentivizing energy saving policies to lower our carbon footprint.
We must strengthen the political power of the community to raise knowledge and education about the climate crisis and the need for urgent action. In order to combat the climate crisis, we need to make big changes to the way we live and run our country. These measures ensure that we receive the access we need to do our part to preserve the planet. Join me today in celebrating Earth Day.

name: Rogan O'Handley
subject: Twitter banned me for questioning the government.
body:
When Twitter BANNED me for exercising my free speech, I didn't have the money or resources to fight back. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6806%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=EsabBNo%2biHPpwm7Zg7aUQQ&sysid=1)
When Twitter BANNED me for exercising my free speech, I didn't have the money or resources to fight back.

|
Fellow American,

If free speech still exists in America today...

Tell me why America's top doctors and scientists are being banned for raising questions about the government's COVID-19 narrative.

Tell me why dozens of conservative activists have been BANNED from Twitter for _disagreeing_ with the Left's absurd gender identity propaganda.

Tell me why anyone who wants to share conservative ideas or question the mainstream narrative is censored - **INCLUDING ME**.

**Twitter - along with other Big Tech corporations like Facebook and Google - are executing the Left's 1984-style plot to control your thoughts and effectively put an end to free speech.**

And the only way to stop it is for you, me, and every conservative patriot across America to stand up and say...

**ENOUGH!**

[**That's why I'm suing Twitter with help from the Center for American Liberty. If you care about protecting your constitutional right to free speech, I urgently need your help.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60986%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LbXkNa1ZZxSpAoEW9X4LrQ&sysid=1)

In case we haven't met, my name is Rogan O'Handley.

A few years ago, I made a life-changing decision:

I left a lucrative job in Hollywood to stand up for what I believe in and do everything I can to defend the values that made America the greatest nation on earth.

**I chose my country over a paycheck.**

_But ever since then, the Leftists in Big Tech and Big Government have done nothing but try to silence and censor me._

And they got their wish.

I was banned from Twitter after California state government officials requested that I be censored.

All because I questioned the results of the 2020 Presidential Election and called for an audit.

And frankly... How could any reasonable person not have questions?

For weeks leading up to the election, the Left spared no expense working to change the rules in their favor.

They allowed ballot harvesting.

They sent millions of ballots to people who had passed away or moved out of state.

They counted hundreds of thousands of mail-in ballots DAYS after the polls had closed.

Then, Joe Biden was declared the winner and folks like you and me were told to sit down, shut up, and accept the results.

Since it was such a "close" election, why were conservatives not allowed to demand an audit or a recount without being censored?

I had serious questions... So I spoke up... Loudly and frequently on and off Twitter.

As you can probably imagine, the Left didn't like what I had to say.

**I dared to challenge their narrative, so I was silenced.**

But that's not even the worst part.

When I tried to figure out why I was censored, I found that bureaucrats working for then-California Secretary of State, Alex Padilla, had explicitly instructed officials at Twitter to silence me.

**Here's exactly what they said:**

**From:** California Secretary of State Communications Department
**To:** Twitter
**Date:** Tuesday, November 17th, 2020 at 12:31 PM

Hi, We wanted to flag this Twitter post:

[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60987%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ATYpMpqxwpV4QBQSecz76Q&sysid=1)
From user @DC_Draino. In this post user claims California of being a culprit of voter fraud, and ignores the fact that we do audit votes. This is a blatant disregard to how our voting process works and creates disinformation and distrust among the general public.

_In other words, the government of California used taxpayer money to restrict my First Amendment rights._

Now I hope you understand why I need your help to defend free speech.

Our rights are under assault by left-wing politicians like Alex Padilla and the most powerful tech companies in the world.

When I decided that I was going to take them on to protect our right to free speech, I knew it would take significant legal expenses and potentially years of going in and out of the courtroom.

**But it's worse than I ever could have imagined...**

These jack-booted thugs are tireless and desperate... So they're not afraid to overwhelm me with legal expenses so I'll be unable to challenge them....

[**And without your support, they'll get their way just like they did last time.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60988%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=M0klusvWenrWSqW8%2bDZWBw&sysid=1)

Again, I wanted to know why I'd been banned out of the blue- so I kept asking questions.

Then I realized... with Kamala Harris set to become the Vice President, she obviously had to give up her seat in the Senate.

And power-hungry Secretary of State Alex Padilla was willing to do **anything** to fill her spot.

Padilla and his staff knew that what I was saying online would significantly hurt his chance of being appointed to the U.S. Senate.

That's when it became clear as day that we had caught Alex Padilla in a plot to collude with Twitter and secure his spot as Kamala Harris's replacement in the U.S. Senate.

Like I mentioned before, I made a choice to put my country over a paycheck.

So, when Twitter BANNED me for exercising my free speech, I didn't have the money or resources to fight back.

**_That's when I reached out to Harmeet Dhillon at the Center for American Liberty._**

_You may have seen Harmeet on Fox News before._

**I'm not exaggerating when I say that Harmeet is one of America's best constitutional lawyers...**

...and one of the only people who has the guts to stand up to the billionaire Big Tech CEO's and Leftist politicians who are silencing and censoring conservatives like you and me.

When Harmeet and her team at the Center for American Liberty heard that I was kicked off Twitter for exercising my right to free speech, they immediately stepped in and filed a lawsuit against Twitter and all those involved in the plot.

There is just one small problem.

As a non-profit organization, the Center for American Liberty relies entirely on the generosity of freedom-loving patriots across the country to defend the Constitution and the values you and I hold dear.

I hear that you're one of those freedom-loving patriots, which is why I have to ask...

[**Will you please make a tax-deductible contribution of $35, $50, $75 or more to the Center for American Liberty to help them sue Twitter, Sen. Alex Padilla, and a handful of other California elected officials for illegally colluding to eliminate the First Amendment?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60989%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eLuvK46panFqPYwv3aI%2bKw&sysid=1)

This is the stuff of Soviet-era Russia, Communist China, and North Korea.

Never before in our country's history have high ranking politicians been able to get away with openly censoring "free" Americans for their personal and political gain.
[ >> DEFEND THE FIRST AMENDMENT NOW << ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60980%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4%2fRZp%2bgfRO5FlbwcVy5Cdg&sysid=1)
Trying to "stop the spread of misinformation" on the 2020 election was just the first part of their plan.

Once they kicked folks like me and President Donald Trump off Twitter for questioning the election, they used those same tactics to spread their bogus COVID propaganda.

You have a chance to make history today, friend.

The First Amendment is under the threat of complete extinction in America.

[**By sending the Center for American Liberty a tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, $75 or more, you can help take on Twitter and stop them from banning more conservative voices.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60981%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=v11QwDo0J%2fB9Fm3Gs89k8w&sysid=1)

I hope that I can count on your help right away.

Sincerely,

**Rogan O'Handley**

P.S. As I'm writing you this letter, the Center for American Liberty is already deeply entrenched in the legal battle against Twitter and Sen. Alex Padilla.

Last summer, they filed the lawsuit - but it was recently wrongly dismissed by the district court.

Harmeet and her team at the Center for American Liberty NEVER give up a fight.

Now, they're taking this legal battle to the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals.

Your contribution is critical to helping the Center for American Liberty win this important lawsuit, deliver justice to those who colluded to silence conservatives like me, and prevent these Leftist elites from destroying the First Amendment.

[**Please, join our fight to defend free speech and send a generous tax-deductible gift of $35 or more to the Center for American Liberty today.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c60982%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1G%2fDHTPrMzieesXNxMgGqg&sysid=1)

Thank you in advance for your support.

This is a blatant disregard to how our voting process works and creates disinformation and distrust among the general public. In other words, the government of California used taxpayer money to restrict my First Amendment rights. Now I hope you understand why I need your help to defend free speech. Our rights are under assault by left-wing politicians like Alex Padilla and the most powerful tech companies in the world. When I decided that I was going to take them on to protect our right to free speech, I knew it would take significant legal expenses and potentially years of going in and out of the courtroom. But it's worse than I ever could have imagined... These jack-booted thugs are tireless and desperate... So they're not afraid to overwhelm me with legal expenses so I'll be unable to challenge them.... Again, I wanted to know why I'd been banned out of the blue- so I kept asking questions. Then I realized... with Kamala Harris set to become the Vice President, she obviously had to give up her seat in the Senate. And power-hungry Secretary of State Alex Padilla was willing to do anything to fill her spot. Padilla and his staff knew that what I was saying online would significantly hurt his chance of being appointed to the U.S. Senate. That's when it became clear as day that we had caught Alex Padilla in a plot to collude with Twitter and secure his spot as Kamala Harris's replacement in the U.S. Senate. Like I mentioned before, I made a choice to put my country over a paycheck. So, when Twitter BANNED me for exercising my free speech, I didn't have the money or resources to fight back. That's when I reached out to Harmeet Dhillon at the Center for American Liberty. You may have seen Harmeet on Fox News before. I'm not exaggerating when I say that Harmeet is one of America's best constitutional lawyers... ...and one of the only people who has the guts to stand up to the billionaire Big Tech CEO's and Leftist politicians who are silencing and censoring conservatives like you and me. When Harmeet and her team at the Center for American Liberty heard that I was kicked off Twitter for exercising my right to free speech, they immediately stepped in and filed a lawsuit against Twitter and all those involved in the plot. There is just one small problem. As a non-profit organization, the Center for American Liberty relies entirely on the generosity of freedom-loving patriots across the country to defend the Constitution and the values you and I hold dear. I hear that you're one of those freedom-loving patriots, which is why I have to ask... This is the stuff of Soviet-era Russia, Communist China, and North Korea. Never before in our country's history have high ranking politicians been able to get away with openly censoring "free" Americans for their personal and political gain. Trying to "stop the spread of misinformation" on the 2020 election was just the first part of their plan. Once they kicked folks like me and President Donald Trump off Twitter for questioning the election, they used those same tactics to spread their bogus COVID propaganda. You have a chance to make history today, friend. The First Amendment is under the threat of complete extinction in America. I hope that I can count on your help right away. Sincerely, Rogan O'Handley P.S. As I'm writing you this letter, the Center for American Liberty is already deeply entrenched in the legal battle against Twitter and Sen. Alex Padilla. Last summer, they filed the lawsuit - but it was recently wrongly dismissed by the district court. Harmeet and her team at the Center for American Liberty NEVER give up a fight. Now, they're taking this legal battle to the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals. Your contribution is critical to helping the Center for American Liberty win this important lawsuit, deliver justice to those who colluded to silence conservatives like me, and prevent these Leftist elites from destroying the First Amendment. Thank you in advance for your support. | The Center For American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization created to fight against growing anti-free-speech and anti-civil liberties trends. | (C) The Center for American Liberty | PO Box 2510, Leesburg, VA 20177 107 S West St. #826, Alexandria VA 22314 _

# Bill McSwain Releases Latest Television Ad
_Bill McSwain will oppose all mandates as Governor_
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- **Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, today released the latest in a series of television ads aimed at sharing his message of safety, security, and prosperity with voters across the Commonwealth.

The ad explains that during the pandemic, opponent Doug Mastriano advocated exposing the private health information of COVID-positive citizens by promoting a government-run effort to share this information publicly, as well as the location of infected individuals across the Commonwealth.

The ad goes on to illustrate that as Governor, McSwain will protect the freedoms of every Pennsylvanian, and will never allow the government to publicly share citizens' private data or information against their will. A U.S. Marine and conservative outsider, McSwain understands the importance of protecting individual liberty, and is committed to opposing all mandates and fighting any attempt by career politicians to infringe on the rights of hard-working Pennsylvanians.
---

|

| **BACKGROUND: **
Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as U.S. Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming a prosecutor, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=bf82d09043&e=b1ec95759b)

I want to direct your attention to three of my planet-protecting colleagues.

| [](https://links.e.leahyforvermont.) Friend, Today is Earth Day, and I want to direct your attention to three of my planet-protecting colleagues: Senators Maggie Hassan, Mark Kelly, and Raphael Warnock. Here are just a couple things these senators have in common:
1. They're each champions in our shared fight to mitigate the worst impacts of the climate crisis.

2. **Each of them are in tight re-election fights against Republicans who, frankly, refuse to take necessary action to protect our precious planet.**

We must keep Senators Hassan, Warnock, and Kelly in office to ensure that the Senate stays blue and fighting for the environmental protections that benefit all of us. **[In honor of Earth Day and before their campaigns' respective month-end deadlines, will you make a contribution of $10 or more right now to be split between these environmental champions? ](https://links.e.leahyforvermont.)** _If you 've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately_ | | [**$10 »**](https://links.e.leahyforvermont.com/els/v2/p2NdcwN~Y_FG/Z2F3c3lzZG13VVYvVnBkRWdvNWNod1JEeTE3cDBmV3dzTUtsT0U0WTBGK2dWQlpvZE1VeTYvQ3lZOUYvQUhnTXBseWNzZmtRV2pUQ2JheU5WbTJFSUVTdUxORTBZYnA3MWJoM3kvbUt6WnM9S0/eW84SEpmdmtSVmRhVEY0RE8wejBUK2FTRXpyQXo5YVpETTdMZUFHN3pXdk9oY0RXeDY4dlpUZ3VGY2lzbnFiMTRSRDB0OFhWcm9oT0JoNXMwL3N3ZEQyZGRqMElYMG0wS0)

In my neighboring state of New Hampshire, Senator Maggie Hassan has spent decades working to keep our air and water clean. I am proud to be a co-sponsor alongside her on the _Clean Energy for America Act_ and work together to invest in clean energy and infrastructure for our nation.
Since joining the Senate just a couple years ago, my colleague Senator Mark Kelly has fought fiercely to combat climate change while creating good-paying jobs for working families. I was grateful for his leadership as we worked to pass the bi-partisan _Growing Climate Solutions Act_ to increase opportunities for farmers and ranchers to steward our environment.
And as senator from Georgia, Senator Raphael Warnock has been a first hand witness to the devastation that flooding and extreme weather can cause. I am so appreciative of his voice, advocacy, and leadership to ensure our caucus's work towards climate and environmental justice centers our most marginalized communities.
To mitigate the growing impacts of climate change, it's time for all of us to ramp up our efforts to protect our earth for our children and grandchildren.
To move forward as a united nation and tackle this mounting challenge, we simply must hold on to our Senate majority and keep these environmental champions in office.
**[Please, join me in supporting Senators Hassan, Warnock, and Kelly by making a contribution of $10 or more to be split between their re-election campaigns today.](https://links.e.leahyforvermont.com/els/v2/8EwKhw93~2FP/Z2F3c3lzZG13VVYvVnBkRWdvNWNod1JEeTE3cDBmV3dzTUtsT0U0WTBGK2dWQlpvZE1VeTYvQ3lZOUYvQUhnTXBseWNzZmtRV2pUQ2JheU5WbTJFSUVTdUxORTBZYnA3MWJoM3kvbUt6WnM9S0/eW84SEpmdmtSVmRhVEY0RE8wejBUK2FTRXpyQXo5YVpETTdMZUFHN3pXdk9oY0RXeDY4dlpUZ3VGY2lzbnFiMTRSRDB0OFhWcm9oT0JoNXMwL3N3ZEQyZGRqMElYMG0wS0)**
Thank you, and wishing you a very happy Earth Day from Marcelle and me.
Sincerely,
Patrick Leahy
U.S. Senator

| Peter,

Happy Earth Day!

Growing up, I cherished the time I spent outdoors, trekking through the woods or picnicking with my family. Now, as a parent, I adore spending days outside with my daughters, whether it's in our own backyard or across our district and Virginia! Our beautiful commonwealth provides ample opportunity to enjoy mountains, rivers, and beaches, and our family makes sure to take advantage of all Virginia has to offer.

However, as we connect with these natural wonders, we must act on our responsibility to protect our environment. We can make positive, lasting change for our children and generations to come by investing in alternative and renewable energy sources and decreasing pollution.

In Congress, I'm devoted to this mission. I serve as Chair of the House Agriculture Committee's Conservation and Forestry Subcommittee, where we aspire to build long-term climate solutions that are beneficial to the environment, farmers, and rural economies.

Last year, I was proud to help pass the bipartisan infrastructure package, which invests overdue dollars in clean, renewable energy. Initiatives like this remind us of the transformative work we can accomplish when we work in service of the common good.

Addressing climate change is one of the biggest challenges our country faces. It is a national security and economic imperative, and I am committed to working on solutions in Congress to tackle climate change and ensure we spend many more Earth Days on a healthy planet.

If you want to support my work in Congress advocating for these critical climate issues, [_**please consider contributing to my re-election campaign today.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/dI27M0w5YZJWh75IvqJa6UCIFhv-DoMhBHCFuoL4YU0=/VTrASsmOeow03ff9UQWNvicaieb6gEkJ-vfEGdVA718=?refcode=BLU-SPAN-20220422-1-EM&amount=25)
