| | Happy Earth Day! Earlier this year, as we dreamed of Spring, we bought our boys a telescope so they could take a closer look at the world's wildlife. Ok, to be honest, it's just the wildlife in our own backyard, but there is still so much to see. My kids have really started to get a kick out of birdwatching: They've seen a squirrel and lots of bugs, too. They're still searching for robins though. I'm sure they'll spot one soon. (They're very determined. Also, we've got a lot of robins around here.) **My boys, and millions of kids just like them, are learning to love our planet more every day, and I want to make sure that feeling can grow throughout their lives.** That's why I'm committed to passing critical climate legislation that will make the planet more livable for generations to come by cutting our dependence on fossil fuels – and preserve the beauty and wonder of the world around them. Some of my most fulfilling moments of being a dad have come from seeing my boys' excitement and wonder when they interact with nature. Each glimpse of a blue jay or a beetle opens up their world a little wider. We owe them – and every other child, grandchild, and generation to come – a world that not only sustains life, but inspires and excites them, and I'm proud to stay with you in this fight until that future is secure. clean_body: | | | Happy Earth Day! Earlier this year, as we dreamed of Spring, we bought our boys a telescope so they could take a closer look at the world's wildlife. Ok, to be honest, it's just the wildlife in our own backyard, but there is still so much to see. My kids have really started to get a kick out of birdwatching: They've seen a squirrel and lots of bugs, too. They're still searching for robins though. I'm sure they'll spot one soon. (They're very determined. Also, we've got a lot of robins around here.) My boys, and millions of kids just like them, are learning to love our planet more every day, and I want to make sure that feeling can grow throughout their lives. That's why I'm committed to passing critical climate legislation that will make the planet more livable for generations to come by cutting our dependence on fossil fuels – and preserve the beauty and wonder of the world around them. Some of my most fulfilling moments of being a dad have come from seeing my boys' excitement and wonder when they interact with nature. Each glimpse of a blue jay or a beetle opens up their world a little wider. We owe them – and every other child, grandchild, and generation to come – a world that not only sustains life, but inspires and excites them, and I'm proud to stay with you in this fight until that future is secure. | | Peter, Today is Earth Day. **In fact, today is the 52nd anniversary of the first Earth Day in 1970, considered by many to be the birthdate of the modern environmental movement in the United States.** Of course, that first Earth Day didn't just happen on its own. It was preceded by the publishing of _Silent Spring_ in 1962, and by a tumultuous decade that saw an awakening of activism across social movements. The months leading up to Earth Day in 1970 saw teach-ins and organizing around the country in preparation for the day's events. One lesser-known key to the success of that first Earth Day? Walther Reuther and the United Auto Workers union. Reuther, the fearless and principled leader of the UAW, put the union's considerable financial and organizational resources behind the Earth Day efforts. He traveled and spoke at campus teach-ins that led up to the holiday, and made the first donation to the then-fledgling effort by Wisconsin Senator Gaylord Nelson to create this official day of action on behalf of the environment. I wanted to share that small piece of history because I know, like Walter Reuther knew in 1970, that working people and the conservation movement have common cause – more common cause than we sometimes realize. And we can find great strength in partnering together to tackle the challenges ahead of us. It remains as true today as it was in 1970. Our planet is facing the greatest challenge we've ever stared down in human history. And if we're going to win the fight against climate change – a fight we must win – we need to be all in. It's long past time to discard the false-choice "jobs vs the environment" framing that the fossil fuel industry has used to divide progressives. I like to think we can walk and chew gum at the same time. We need to invest in the clean energy economy to move us away from fossil fuels and build the high-skilled workforce that will power us into the renewable energy future. And we can create those jobs – family wage union jobs – right here in Oregon, and make our state a leader in renewable energy generation, manufacturing and research. **On this Earth Day, let us take inspiration from those activists – both labor and conservationist – who came together 52 years ago. clean_body: | | | Peter, Today is Earth Day. In fact, today is the 52nd anniversary of the first Earth Day in 1970, considered by many to be the birthdate of the modern environmental movement in the United States. Of course, that first Earth Day didn't just happen on its own. It was preceded by the publishing of Silent Spring in 1962, and by a tumultuous decade that saw an awakening of activism across social movements. The months leading up to Earth Day in 1970 saw teach-ins and organizing around the country in preparation for the day's events. One lesser-known key to the success of that first Earth Day? Walther Reuther and the United Auto Workers union. Reuther, the fearless and principled leader of the UAW, put the union's considerable financial and organizational resources behind the Earth Day efforts. He traveled and spoke at campus teach-ins that led up to the holiday, and made the first donation to the then-fledgling effort by Wisconsin Senator Gaylord Nelson to create this official day of action on behalf of the environment. I wanted to share that small piece of history because I know, like Walter Reuther knew in 1970, that working people and the conservation movement have common cause – more common cause than we sometimes realize. And we can find great strength in partnering together to tackle the challenges ahead of us. It remains as true today as it was in 1970. Our planet is facing the greatest challenge we've ever stared down in human history. And if we're going to win the fight against climate change – a fight we must win – we need to be all in. It's long past time to discard the false-choice "jobs vs the environment" framing that the fossil fuel industry has used to divide progressives. I like to think we can walk and chew gum at the same time. We need to invest in the clean energy economy to move us away from fossil fuels and build the high-skilled workforce that will power us into the renewable energy future. And we can create those jobs – family wage union jobs – right here in Oregon, and make our state a leader in renewable energy generation, manufacturing and research. On this Earth Day, let us take inspiration from those activists – both labor and conservationist – who came together 52 years ago. And recommit ourselves to this work, because we are stronger together and our planet needs us. Hi team,

We have a busy weekend ahead, but before then, I wanted to share some of my thoughts about the debate last night.

It was clear that not every candidate is prepared to answer the tough questions that every Senate candidate must face. When it comes to crafting actual policy and legislation — the things that directly affect our families, communities, and economy — not every candidate could give a clear answer to voters.

That's what set our campaign apart. We have clear, detailed plans to tackle the issues that Pennsylvanians are facing right now.

We are going to eliminate the filibuster and protect the right to vote, protect women's right to choose, protect union rights and protect Social Security and Medicare. We are going to reform our tax code to make sure the wealthiest Americans pay their fair share.

We are going to prove that we can take real action to fight climate change while protecting and creating good jobs in Pennsylvania. We are going to bring the cost of living down for working families and seniors — on things like prescription drugs, health care, child care, and student loans. And we are going to take a comprehensive approach to combating the epidemic of gun violence in Pennsylvania.

We can't deliver for Pennsylvanians if we don't win in November. Last night, I believe we proved to voters that this is the campaign that can do both.
**[This is a competitive race, and it's coming down to the wire. We have another debate on Monday, and in the meantime we'll be out talking to voters, answering questions and putting in the work to win. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

I wanted to give you an update on our fundraising.

Since we let you know that our fundraising was trending downward this
year, more than 2,500 grassroots supporters have stepped up and helped us
turn things around. Now, we’re on track in April to raise more than we did
in March.

That’s great news. But the team and I noticed another concerning
comparison. In April 2020, the last time we had a slate of primaries,
Justice Democrats raised $167,421. This month, we are 36% behind pace to
raise what we did in April ‘20.

In 2020, we elected Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman. It was a huge year for
Justice Democrats. And we needed every single dollar to defeat corporate
Democrats with the backing of the establishment, Wall Street, and
corporate PACs.

We need every single dollar this year too, because we’re trying to elect 5
more Justice Democrats to join the Squad. We’re up against well-funded
corporate Democrats again. The establishment doesn’t want to see our
candidates win — they don’t want us to upset the status quo.

The hard truth is nearly 90% of Congressional races are won by candidates
who spend the most money. You’ve probably seen me write that before,
because it’s so important. Some of the incumbents we’re facing had
millions in their campaign accounts before our candidates even announced
they were running. Some are raising more than 2x or 3x as much as our
working-class, progressive candidates.

That’s why we need you to donate for the first time today.

We know we can win races even if we don’t have more money than our
corporate-funded opponents and their Super PACs. But we have to close some
of the gap.

So, Peter, can you
chip in today to help us take on corporate Democrats and elect our slate
of progressives?

I appreciate so, so much whatever you can give today, whether it’s $3,
$27, $100 or anything at all. We will never take corporate PAC money and
we will always rely on our grassroots movement.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas, Executive Director

# Brad Little Refuses to Debate, Won't Condemn Democrats who Hijack the Republican Primary!
---
| [ ](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=bc49420ea0&e=823fa8e224)
---
Brad Little wants Democrats to vote for him. Why would YOU support him?
| Mr. Little says his record is "non-debatable"... Let's fact-check his claim. Little ordered the complete shutdown of our state, causing unprecedented unemployment and closing thousands of small businesses — many of which never reopened. Little fined businesses and threatened their licenses. Under Little's shutdown, a mother was arrested for taking her kids to the park. A family was fined for holding a yard sale, and Idahoans were arrested for attending an outdoor church service! Little issued a series of emergency orders for more than two years in order to maintain his expanded powers and allow him to change the law and spend more than a billion dollars without legislative approval. He changed our election laws and suspended our right to vote in person. He increased our state's dependence on federal dollars, wasted our surplus by increasing spending by more than 20%, and failed to provide meaningful and lasting tax relief. He reinstated the mask and vaccine mandates that I had ended, and he continues to violate our state constitution by clinging to power even when he is out of state. He took thousands of dollars in campaign contributions from Big Pharma and then he vetoed legislation protecting most Idahoans from vaccine mandates, adding to the number of Idahoans who have been fired and face ongoing discrimination for their personal health choices. He sits by uselessly as Critical Race Theory and other forms of leftist indoctrination are taught in our schools and he even claims "it's not happening in Idaho" despite overwhelming evidence to the contrary. With a record of failure and corruption like that, perhaps it's not surprising that Little is refusing to debate. I am still committed to holding him accountable, though. Fortunately, you too have an opportunity to hold him accountable at the ballot box. On May 17, Vote McGeachin for Governor. Vote for the Proven, Conservative Leader. Vote to Make Idaho Free Again!

name: America First Veterans Initiative
subject: These heroes need YOU!
body:
Peter, **Conservative veterans are the KEY to taking back the House. **

The fierce courage and love of country that our country’s veterans have is unmatched.

They had what it takes to defend America from our enemies abroad, and now that they’ve hung up their uniforms, they’re not afraid to take on our enemies at home: _socialism, tyranny, and woke propaganda. _

Sen. Grassley has lost his backbone when it comes to protecting our democracy.
| | | Peter – when I was on MSNBC, they asked me: "why do you think Chuck Grassley is so all in on Trump and the Big Lie?"

**I have quite a few thoughts on that. Let me explain.**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44437851/341584874/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk843-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMmJhMjdiOS02NmMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PeaqQ8orQonzP9BrNwWtk3UEBSK7Oy9b5aU4Z6qYwfA=)
I watched Sen. Grassley stand on stage with Donald Trump and _enthusiastically_ _accept_ his "complete and total endorsement."

I watched Sen. Grassley _fervently_ _defend_ Donald Trump's attempts to use the Department of Justice to overturn our free and fair election.

clean_body: | | | | Time is running out to save our planet and protect our children’s future, Peter Willis. 60% of Americans support a Green New Deal, including 81% of Democrats, 57% of Independents, and even one-third of Republicans.1 Like almost every other progressive policy, it’s enormously popular — so what’s standing in our way of ending the climate crisis? The fossil fuel lobbyists and the politicians they bribe. When I get to Congress, you can count on me to fight like hell to take back our planet from the lobbyists and polluters destroying it for profit, and pass a Green New Deal. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | The fossil fuel industry and polluters are destroying our planet with zero accountability and aided by taxpayer subsidies. In the last 20 years, the oil and gas industry has spent over $2 billion lobbying Congress. In return, they receive $650 billion per year in subsidies. In this country, if you litter it’s a crime, but if you destroy the planet for profit, you get a subsidy. Everyone sees how this works, right? The members of Congress these lobbyists pay are the ones blocking necessary climate action. Already this cycle, they’ve given $13,305,590 to 218 Republicans and 118 Democrats. They are ALL complicit in the destruction of our planet, putting profit over the health, lives, and future of our children. We may be the last generation that can do something about our climate crisis, and we MUST act. No more delays. No more half-measures. Policies that realize a Green New Deal would put us on the path to giving future generations a safe, healthy future, and would restructure our economy into one that’s responsible and sustainable (not to mention it would create millions of green, well-paying jobs). I will never sell out our communities or our children’s future to lobbyists or fossil fuel executives. That means I need your help to defeat the people who will. Thanks for fighting with me, Melanie 1"" Data for Progress, April 19, 2021. Friend, This Earth Day we are lifting up the many matriach leaders and land protectors who are fighting for our communities and the sacred systems of life _every day of the year._ We know that as threats to the environment increase, women protectors are harmed first and worst. This is a critical time to stand with courageous leaders who are fighting every day to protect human rights, forests, water, climate, communities and future generations. Traditional Ecological Knowledge, also called by other names including Indigenous Knowledge or Native Science, (hereafter, TEK) refers to the evolving knowledge acquired by indigenous and local peoples over hundreds or thousands of years through direct contact with the environment. It includes an intimate and detailed knowledge of plants, animals, and natural phenomena, the development and use of appropriate technologies for hunting, fishing, trapping, agriculture, and forestry, and a holistic knowledge, or "world view" which parallels the scientific discipline of ecology. While we strategize towards equitable, rapid, large-scale emissions reductions, we must learn from Indigenous knowledge and amplify women protectors. Our lives and our Earth depend on it. -Crystal

clean_body: Plus what she's up this weekend!! | Friend, This Earth Day we are lifting up the many matriach leaders and land protectors who are fighting for our communities and the sacred systems of life every day of the year. We know that as threats to the environment increase, women protectors are harmed first and worst. This is a critical time to stand with courageous leaders who are fighting every day to protect human rights, forests, water, climate, communities and future generations. Traditional Ecological Knowledge, also called by other names including Indigenous Knowledge or Native Science, (hereafter, TEK) refers to the evolving knowledge acquired by indigenous and local peoples over hundreds or thousands of years through direct contact with the environment. It includes an intimate and detailed knowledge of plants, animals, and natural phenomena, the development and use of appropriate technologies for hunting, fishing, trapping, agriculture, and forestry, and a holistic knowledge, or "world view" which parallels the scientific discipline of ecology. While we strategize towards equitable, rapid, large-scale emissions reductions, we must learn from Indigenous knowledge and amplify women protectors. Our lives and our Earth depend on it. -Crystal Crystal's Earth Day 2022 Appearances TUES April 26, 11:30 am Vigiling for the Earth and All People (100 N. We must lower the tax burden on Michigan businesses and families | | | **Peter,**

Garrett Soldano here.**I know a lot of folks are still feeling the sting from Tax Day on Monday** \- Jennifer and I sure are.

Traveling all across the state of Michigan these past two years, I've heard a lot of stories. Too often, I hear about families and businesses leaving Michigan for states with a lower tax burden - which is why Michigan was losing population even before Whitmer's lockdowns.

It's simple, folks - **taxes are too high** , and Michiganders can't trust career politicians or insiders to do anything about it. _Governor Whitmer has fought for higher taxes at every chance_ \- attempting to hike the gas tax up to 45 cents (the highest in the nation!) and vetoing bills to provide some tax relief to taxpayers suffering under Bidenflation.

**My plan?** Let's start with adding some common sense to the equation - allow Michiganders to keep more of their hard-earned paychecks!

Peter, I am going to get to work on Day 1 to cut the income tax and allow Michiganders to see more of every paycheck. The legislature finally gave Whitmer a bill to lower the income tax after its "temporary" increase 15 years ago. **_She vetoed it._** _Our movement is going to get it done._

To help bring jobs back, we're going to lower the business tax and help create a small business revolution here in Michigan. **No more handouts and taxpayer subsidies to woke corporations.**

Gretchen's spending spree of federal COVID cash has ballooned our budget - and even with a Republican legislature, spending has increased drastically. Folks, I'm not just going to the balance the budget - _we're going to cut the budget_ , slash unnecessary spending and get big government OUT of our daily lives.

Gretchen Whitmer tried to raise our gas tax to the highest in the nation -**I'm going to cut it.**

I'm a small business owner, not a career politician - I know that our money is better spent by you and your family than politicians in Lansing.

If the IRS left you a few bucks to spare after Monday, [please consider pitching in](https://GarrettForMichigan.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0473a6037c1be0f2423e4fd&id=47d9ee537c&e=fe4b890356) to our campaign to **LOWER TAXES** and protect Michigan paychecks.

body:
Improving our economy, protecting our environment

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44439163/341590075/-1388647933?refcode=EM_P_220422EarthDay_H_CJ_30DO_5_G_TESTB_EDLogo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWM0YjI0ZS02YWMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lO2rBdraGrSYQkGqLmv9lA86TOs_4OwryZwurhfd1l0=&emci=2f48bc46-6ac2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a9c4b24e-6ac2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6362892) Happy Earth Day!

Today, more than a billion people will celebrate a day to protect the planet and make our world a happier, healthier place to live. Today also serves as a reminder that we must commit to real, strong, rapid action to combat the climate crisis before it’s too late.

Here in Tennessee, we’re facing longer and hotter heat waves, longer mosquito season, more severe droughts, and more inland flooding. We’re even home to the 6th fastest-warming city in the U.S. – Chattanooga. It’s clear we need to act now to protect our residents from the worsening effects of the climate crisis, and we need to act fast. Every day that our government pushes back new legislation on clean energy, efficient building codes, public transit, and more, they put us in greater danger. | **_WHAT DO YOU THINK?_
Would you support a bill that pairs labor programs with measures to combat the climate crisis, improving our economy while protecting our environment?**
---
[YES](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44439164/341590076/-1388647933?refcode=EM_P_220422EarthDay_H_CJ_30DO_5_G_TESTB_YES&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWM0YjI0ZS02YWMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lO2rBdraGrSYQkGqLmv9lA86TOs_4OwryZwurhfd1l0=&emci=2f48bc46-6ac2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a9c4b24e-6ac2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6362892)
[NO](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44439165/341590077/-1388647933?refcode=EM_P_220422EarthDay_H_CJ_30DO_5_G_TESTB_NO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWM0YjI0ZS02YWMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lO2rBdraGrSYQkGqLmv9lA86TOs_4OwryZwurhfd1l0=&emci=2f48bc46-6ac2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a9c4b24e-6ac2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6362892)

We at the Tennessee Democratic Party support the Green New Deal and similar legislation because it drives home our main mission, to create a better future for the hard-working people of Tennessee. This movement goes beyond demanding our government devote long-overdue resources to combat the climate crisis. It demands they do it in a way that benefits real people through job growth and training programs, fair wages, and consistent community engagement to create the best outcomes for all. It shows us what life could be like if our politicians decided to value people over profit.

We have a chance this year to move our legislature closer to this goal. I know with supporters like you, we can make real progress.

Wishing you and your family well,

Cassie Jackson

We’re committed to registering 200,000 new voters ahead of the 2022 elections. Given what’s at stake, we can’t afford to miss our chance.

A few weeks ago, I voted to pass a landmark bipartisan bill aimed at capping the price of insulin at $35 per month for Americans with diabetes. Nearly ten percent of adults in my district live with diabetes and, if passed, this legislation will save New Jersey families thousands of dollars.

No person should have to choose between putting food on the dinner table or taking their prescribed medications. Lowering prescription drug costs is a core pillar of my Affordability Agenda for Jersey and I will always vote with New Jersey families in mind.

body:
They are coming for me |
---
| | [ ](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=0d16383343&e=44b8c466b0)
---
| | Dear ,
As media assaults strengthen and as the Lying Left disposes every tool in their arsenal to get me off the ballot, I wanted to take a moment to remind you why I am running \- and why the Arizona Secretary of State race means so much to me, and why it should matter to everyone.
**_Why Mark Finchem?_**
**As you may remember, I have been fighting for Election Integrity since day one. I paid for the initial Election Integrity hearings out of pocket. **

**_I pushed for and executed the Maricopa Audit, “America’s Audit,” which uncovered unprecedented amounts of fraud, showing that the Arizona 2020 election was irredeemably compromised._**

But I didn’t stop there. Meanwhile, I was developing and working with respected third parties to develop currency-grade ballot security and watermarking to ensure that there is never dispute as to who voted, and whether or not the ballot was legally cast.

After developing this technology, I have been and currently am pushing to have this critical, groundbreaking technology adopted nationwide.

These initiatives led to election audits taking place around the country, providing continuous and mounting evidence that the 2020 election was, in fact, stolen by the Democrats to illegally prevent Donald Trump from winning the election.

**This led to applying significant pressure to AG Mark Brnovich’s office to investigate the counts of Election Fraud. I maintain to this day that there needs to be perp walks, and, until there is, our work is not yet finished.**

_What I need you to understand, folks, is that I have done all of this while campaigning for Secretary of State, while being a representative in Arizona’s legislature._

**This represents just a fraction of what I could do, and what I _WILL_ do, when I am elected Arizona’s Secretary of State.**

**_The Secretary of State is responsible for overseeing and protecting the State’s Elections, something at which current Secretary of State, Katie Hobbes, has failed spectacularly._**

As Secretary of State, I will:
* Adopt ballot protection watermarking that is currency-grade.
* Ensure we only have in-person, paper balloting
* Ensure there are no “3 AM ballot drops”
* Fight against ballot harvesting
* Apply pressure to the Attorney General’s office to prosecute to the fullest extent of the law anyone who threatens the sanctity and integrity of Arizona’s elections.

The end result of this is that Arizona WILL be the GOLD STANDARD of Election Integrity!
**_Why Arizona?_**
It is clear that there was Election Fraud all across the Country. The key question at play is why does Arizona matter so much?
---
| [ ](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=5a957ca666&e=44b8c466b0)
---
| The key goes back to looking at who has won Arizona’s Presidential Elections in the last 70 years.

In the last 70 years, there have been exactly TWO times that a Democrat has won the Presidential Vote in Arizona.

**The first, was in Bill Clinton’s 1996 Presidential Run. **

**_The second was the 2020 election._**

In such a historically Red State, if the Left is able to take the election through illicit means, then there is no limit to what they will be able to do if left unchecked.

**The fact stands that Arizona is the EPICENTER of the Democrats’ operation to take over America by any means necessary, even if that means betraying the integrity of America’s historically free and fair elections.**

If we can’t defend Arizona, then America’s elections don’t stand a chance.
**_What I need from you_**
Right now, everything hinges on Arizona’s Secretary of State Race.

**And as with most things, there is good news and there is bad news. **

**_The good news is polling shows we are winning the race.

The bad news is 70% of voters are undecided._**

This is a question of education and exposure. The Arizona voter base needs to know WHY Election Integrity Matters and that I am the one who can save it.

**[Unfortunately, this requires a lot of money. ](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=d3b0134376&e=44b8c466b0) This is a state-wide campaign in a hotly contested election.**

**_And here’s the reality. This is our election to lose. We simply need to blast the airwaves and make sure every door in Arizona gets knocked. If we do this, we win._**

| | Friend,

I am running for Congress because I am sick and tired of what’s happening in D.C. My special election is in less than 2 months, and I’m facing 47 other candidates!

Yes, you read that right...47 other candidates!

That’s why I’m reaching out to you right now. I need your help; I need your family’s help; I need your neighbor’s help. Sarah Palin

subject: Happy Earth Day 🌎
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Kim Schrier for Congress
body:
Today marks 52 years since the first Earth Day was observed in the United States. What started with Americans across the country demanding protections for our environment has grown into a global movement urging action and awareness of the climate crisis. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44424309/341538149/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OWQ3ZTVlMi00Y2MyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DhrneT6ds0rplPBX8wOLjglA1rAZRka2yFUuu4QSmgo=&emci=681a7f5b-7cc1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=89d7e5e2-4cc2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15820338)
---
Peter,

Today marks 52 years since the first Earth Day was observed in the United States. What started with Americans across the country demanding protections for our environment has grown into a global movement urging action and awareness of the climate crisis.

Kim understands that climate change is the greatest moral issue of our time. Before she attended medical school, Kim worked at the Environmental Protection Agency. Now as a congresswoman, protecting our environment has been one of her top priorities.

subject: Your thoughts on the Second Amendment
body:
The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation’s history and undermine our Constitution—with a special emphasis
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm5me36i13eqmprsktn64mreukoq51bahvairj68_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2usqn6tbgs9jj2cr7cor68p74s5p7ctjjmeqn0plge8qb8tj3mhincpb56mrbedtnq9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shgcooj9ddicur64phks2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5c1hmaob0c9h649fg)
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf8no30is0l18j99sjog87q8qicrg62gl1a2go48_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdim2o32c9h2bs) Dear Friend of the Constitution, The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation’s history and undermine our Constitution—with a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment. Today, you’re receiving Hillsdale College’s **Second Amendment Survey** because you’re someone who understands that education is essential to the defense of liberty. We are reaching and teaching millions of Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding. Could you take a few minutes to complete our **Second Amendment Survey** using the secure link below? **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z08oks3aq9slir3ad08911ohb8i83j93mp5gb3eo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdim2o32c9h2bs "https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/")** Your timely survey answers will help us reach and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year about the importance of liberty—which includes the rights protected by the Second Amendment. There is no question that one of the Left’s most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our liberty is **ignorance**. Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in 1844. Today our educational outreach efforts include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty, such as the Second Amendment. As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler observed in _Imprimis_ , our digest of liberty that reaches millions of Americans: “The Second Amendment is an expression of **first principles**.” This means the Second Amendment is essential for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom. This kind of thinking is foreign to most college and university campuses today, where “safe spaces” are now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here’s an example... Not long ago, the University of Virginia canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day. Why? The administration was concerned that firing guns in honor of those who served their country and did their part to defend our freedom would cause “panic” among the student body. Unfortunately, there are many more such examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the ongoing decline in civics education in America. **But instead of just TALKING, it’s more important to DO something about it.** That’s why we have been working to expand our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. And this work continues today. That’s why I would like your answers to our brief **Second Amendment Survey.** You can complete the survey today at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt0rmgt5nfcta0e886bvpg8cmg3rqm9iikm3aul0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdim2o32c9h2bs)** We believe that an educated citizenry is essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan said, “Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction.” Do you agree? I hope so. This is why we **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution. It’s also why we need your help today. As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation. Our independence from the government means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. It also means your gift really matters. **Today, you have a great opportunity to help preserve liberty—including the Second Amendment—for future generations.** After completing your **Second Amendment Survey** , please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous tax-deductible gift today. And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we’ll send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our thank you. This hat commemorates our partnership with USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and Paralympics. But hurry—supplies are limited! Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed **Second Amendment Survey.** Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
**P.S.** Our Constitution—including the Second Amendment—is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take our **Second Amendment Survey** at the secure link below. It will only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve liberty for future generations. Thank you! **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztvnh11r9b9p2rhm9et4fdkfcld8cdjukuu3pe3g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdim2o32c9h2bs)**

name: Rogan O'Handley
subject: Is free speech dead?
body:
When Twitter BANNED me for exercising my free speech, I didn't have the money or resources to fight back.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z1culqscpr3lru3j7ls12v175jd8585jusb0ohmg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ugo76sdimqrrcpdkc8o66p9nctg71p35m1pmfd37c6rj4pb2m8obct9jmcpr9c37q9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shgcooj9ddic1pbephge2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5c1hmaob6ctj649fg)
When Twitter BANNED me for exercising my free speech, I didn't have the money or resources to fight back.

|
Fellow American,

If free speech still exists in America today...

Tell me why America's top doctors and scientists are being banned for raising questions about the government's COVID-19 narrative.

Tell me why dozens of conservative activists have been BANNED from Twitter for _disagreeing_ with the Left's absurd gender identity propaganda.

Tell me why anyone who wants to share conservative ideas or question the mainstream narrative is censored - **INCLUDING ME** .

**Twitter – along with other Big Tech corporations like Facebook and Google – are executing the Left's 1984-style plot to control your thoughts and effectively put an end to free speech.**

And the only way to stop it is for you, me, and every conservative patriot across America to stand up and say...

**ENOUGH!**

[**That's why I'm suing Twitter with help from the Center for American Liberty. If you care about protecting your constitutional right to free speech, I urgently need your help.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zms3akb8ta06eurk4735n2tc6vbalc2pm9otqfn8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdim2pj7cph2bs)

In case we haven't met, my name is Rogan O'Handley.

A few years ago, I made a life-changing decision:

I left a lucrative job in Hollywood to stand up for what I believe in and do everything I can to defend the values that made America the greatest nation on earth.

**I chose my country over a paycheck.**

_But ever since then, the Leftists in Big Tech and Big Government have done nothing but try to silence and censor me._

And they got their wish.

I was banned from Twitter after California state government officials requested that I be censored.

All because I questioned the results of the 2020 Presidential Election and called for an audit.

And frankly... How could any reasonable person not have questions?

For weeks leading up to the election, the Left spared no expense working to change the rules in their favor.

They allowed ballot harvesting.

They sent millions of ballots to people who had passed away or moved out of state.

They counted hundreds of thousands of mail-in ballots DAYS after the polls had closed.

Then, Joe Biden was declared the winner and folks like you and me were told to sit down, shut up, and accept the results.

Since it was such a "close" election, why were conservatives not allowed to demand an audit or a recount without being censored?

I had serious questions... So I spoke up... Loudly and frequently on and off Twitter.

As you can probably imagine, the Left didn't like what I had to say.

**I dared to challenge their narrative, so I was silenced.**

But that's not even the worst part.

When I tried to figure out why I was censored, I found that bureaucrats working for then-California Secretary of State, Alex Padilla, had explicitly instructed officials at Twitter to silence me.

**Here's exactly what they said:**

**From:** California Secretary of State Communications Department
**To:** Twitter
**Date:** Tuesday, November 17th, 2020 at 12:31 PM

Hi, We wanted to flag this Twitter post:

[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zge6p0sg6oug9udec051iehg9mnie3onjb62l00o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdim2pj7cph2bs)
>From user @DC_Draino. In this post user claims California of being a culprit of voter fraud, and ignores the fact that we do audit votes. This is a blatant disregard to how our voting process works and creates disinformation and distrust among the general public.

_In other words, the government of California used taxpayer money to restrict my First Amendment rights._

Now I hope you understand why I need your help to defend free speech.

Our rights are under assault by left-wing politicians like Alex Padilla and the most powerful tech companies in the world.

When I decided that I was going to take them on to protect our right to free speech, I knew it would take significant legal expenses and potentially years of going in and out of the courtroom.

**But it's worse than I ever could have imagined...**

These jack-booted thugs are tireless and desperate... So they're not afraid to overwhelm me with legal expenses so I'll be unable to challenge them....

[**And without your support, they'll get their way just like they did last time.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zf9csv9phhj39gor1jqlv6cnulv958lobnilfgno_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdim2pj7cph2bs)

Again, I wanted to know why I'd been banned out of the blue- so I kept asking questions.

Then I realized... with Kamala Harris set to become the Vice President, she obviously had to give up her seat in the Senate.

And power-hungry Secretary of State Alex Padilla was willing to do **anything** to fill her spot.

Padilla and his staff knew that what I was saying online would significantly hurt his chance of being appointed to the U.S. Senate.

That's when it became clear as day that we had caught Alex Padilla in a plot to collude with Twitter and secure his spot as Kamala Harris's replacement in the U.S. Senate.

Like I mentioned before, I made a choice to put my country over a paycheck.

So, when Twitter BANNED me for exercising my free speech, I didn't have the money or resources to fight back.

**_That's when I reached out to Harmeet Dhillon at the Center for American Liberty._**

_You may have seen Harmeet on Fox News before._

**I'm not exaggerating when I say that Harmeet is one of America's best constitutional lawyers...**

...and one of the only people who has the guts to stand up to the billionaire Big Tech CEO's and Leftist politicians who are silencing and censoring conservatives like you and me.

When Harmeet and her team at the Center for American Liberty heard that I was kicked off Twitter for exercising my right to free speech, they immediately stepped in and filed a lawsuit against Twitter and all those involved in the plot.

There is just one small problem.

As a non-profit organization, the Center for American Liberty relies entirely on the generosity of freedom-loving patriots across the country to defend the Constitution and the values you and I hold dear.

I hear that you're one of those freedom-loving patriots, which is why I have to ask...

[**Will you please make a tax-deductible contribution of $35, $50, $75 or more to the Center for American Liberty to help them sue Twitter, Sen. Alex Padilla, and a handful of other California elected officials for illegally colluding to eliminate the First Amendment?**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z8qcvcrapbs9v3bnn51us94026c0hm5k7a22c18o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdim2pj7cph2bs)

This is the stuff of Soviet-era Russia, Communist China, and North Korea.

Never before in our country's history have high ranking politicians been able to get away with openly censoring "free" Americans for their personal and political gain.
[ >> DEFEND THE FIRST AMENDMENT NOW << ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zd3lr72t7tsv76c3brnr8et2ht98ml1cof2hknuo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0cdim2pj7cph2bs)
Trying to "stop the spread of misinformation" on the 2020 election was just the first part of their plan.

Once they kicked folks like me and President Donald Trump off Twitter for questioning the election, they used those same tactics to spread their bogus COVID propaganda.

The First Amendment is under the threat of complete extinction in America.

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44440755/341597589/306376849?refcode=EM_BS_CANNING_220422_FR_FIELD_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzk2MmUzYS03MGMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Nbe6ncWIFI3e4JWusoTjZdDlI7Z_PaA47ZlTeU_y_Fk=) [Field programs can win or lose campaigns.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44440756/341597590/558575031?refcode=EM_BS_CANNING_220422_FR_FIELD_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzk2MmUzYS03MGMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Nbe6ncWIFI3e4JWusoTjZdDlI7Z_PaA47ZlTeU_y_Fk=)

What’s a field program? That’s just “campaign-speak” for knocking on doors, making phone calls, and connecting with voters in every community. And we’re the only campaign in this race doing that! We know we have strong grassroots support because we’re growing it every day.

With the May 17th primary rapidly approaching, Doyle Canning’s extraordinary team of volunteers has been out in the community connecting with thousands of voters. [ And we’ve been getting incredible feedback.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44440757/341597591/558575031?refcode=EM_BS_CANNING_220422_FR_FIELD_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzk2MmUzYS03MGMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Nbe6ncWIFI3e4JWusoTjZdDlI7Z_PaA47ZlTeU_y_Fk=)

From the Coast to Corvallis to Eugene, our volunteers find that most folks they talk to are already supporting Doyle! Even if voters are undecided, once they learn about Doyle, they are on board with our campaign and glad we stopped by.

[But running a field program isn’t cheap!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44440758/341597592/558575031?refcode=EM_BS_CANNING_220422_FR_FIELD_A0_na_U1_X1_M1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNzk2MmUzYS03MGMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Nbe6ncWIFI3e4JWusoTjZdDlI7Z_PaA47ZlTeU_y_Fk=) It might not sound like much but canvassing supplies like campaign literature, snacks, and clipboards all add up!

Kirsten

---

| | Peter, Today is Earth Day, a global day of action on climate change. It's important for all of us to be clear about our commitment to protect the environment. **So today, Peter, I'm making these commitments to you:** ✔️ I believe the science on climate change is clear, and I will take on those in Congress who obstruct meaningful action. ✔️ In Congress, I'll work to reduce our country's carbon footprint through the development of renewable energy. ✔️ I'll work to make our economy greener, which will create millions of jobs while saving the planet. ✔️ And I will always fight to protect our precious Long Island Sound from those who would pollute it for profit and continue to deliver federal grants to preserve the Sound for generations to come. **Climate change is not theoretical. We're living with the consequences of yesterday's decisions.** And future generations will have to live the consequences of the decisions we make today. To that end, combating climate change can't be a theoretical exercise. We all have to make a difference in our communities _now_. It's not enough to punish polluters. We also have to reward good actors while stimulating the economy. Here in Nassau County, I'm sponsoring a bill incentivising developers to build green by cutting fees for developers who upgrade their properties. **The end result is government and business working together to create greener communities.** Peter, the only way we can have a real climate revolution is with a broad coalition of partners. No one government agency or company can do it alone. We've all got to unite towards a common goal and fight for our climate together. I'm proud to be part of that movement today and every day. clean_body: | | | Peter, Today is Earth Day, a global day of action on climate change. It's important for all of us to be clear about our commitment to protect the environment. So today, Peter, I'm making these commitments to you: ✔️ I believe the science on climate change is clear, and I will take on those in Congress who obstruct meaningful action. ✔️ In Congress, I'll work to reduce our country's carbon footprint through the development of renewable energy. ✔️ I'll work to make our economy greener, which will create millions of jobs while saving the planet. ✔️ And I will always fight to protect our precious Long Island Sound from those who would pollute it for profit and continue to deliver federal grants to preserve the Sound for generations to come. Climate change is not theoretical. We're living with the consequences of yesterday's decisions. And future generations will have to live the consequences of the decisions we make today. To that end, combating climate change can't be a theoretical exercise. We all have to make a difference in our communities now. It's not enough to punish polluters. We also have to reward good actors while stimulating the economy. Here in Nassau County, I'm sponsoring a bill incentivising developers to build green by cutting fees for developers who upgrade their properties. The end result is government and business working together to create greener communities. Peter, the only way we can have a real climate revolution is with a broad coalition of partners. No one government agency or company can do it alone. We've all got to unite towards a common goal and fight for our climate together. I'm proud to be part of that movement today and every day. Happy Earth Day, friends!
From the farmlands and waterways of the Eastern Shore to our main streets throughout Central Maryland, to the mountains of Garrett County – Maryland has incredible natural resources that make our state a great place to live, work and raise a family.
Unfortunately, climate change, which continues to pose a tremendous threat to our state, has cost us $10 billion over the past decade, and is expected to cost us $19 billion in real estate damage alone this century. It is also causing increasingly severe storms, worsening pollution, poorer air quality, and more frequent extreme heat events, burdening low-income communities and communities of color the most.
**Once a national leader on climate change, Maryland continues to fall behind, putting our health, safety and economic future at risk. As your next Governor, I plan to change that.**
Aruna and I have a detailed plan to re-establish Maryland as the national and global leader we should be by setting aggressive clean energy and emissions reductions standards, partnering with local leaders to combat the effects of climate change, and build a more resilient Maryland.
**I’ve also signed a resolution calling for the next governor to support legislation that would get Maryland to 100% carbon-free electricity by 2035** , to remove trash incineration from the state’s “clean energy” classification during the 2023 legislative session, and for 40% of all clean energy and climate benefits to go to “historically disadvantaged communities” in Maryland.
We’re running out of time to act on climate, friend, which is exactly why we need to win this race — so we can put this plan into action and create a clean energy future for our state.

clean_body: | = As your next Governor, I pledge to get Maryland to 100% carbon-free electricity by 2035. | Happy Earth Day, friends! From the farmlands and waterways of the Eastern Shore to our main streets throughout Central Maryland, to the mountains of Garrett County – Maryland has incredible natural resources that make our state a great place to live, work and raise a family. Unfortunately, climate change, which continues to pose a tremendous threat to our state, has cost us $10 billion over the past decade, and is expected to cost us $19 billion in real estate damage alone this century. It is also causing increasingly severe storms, worsening pollution, poorer air quality, and more frequent extreme heat events, burdening low-income communities and communities of color the most. Once a national leader on climate change, Maryland continues to fall behind, putting our health, safety and economic future at risk. As your next Governor, I plan to change that. Aruna and I have a detailed plan to re-establish Maryland as the national and global leader we should be by setting aggressive clean energy and emissions reductions standards, partnering with local leaders to combat the effects of climate change, and build a more resilient Maryland. I’ve also signed a resolution calling for the next governor to support legislation that would get Maryland to 100% carbon-free electricity by 2035 , to remove trash incineration from the state’s “clean energy” classification during the 2023 legislative session, and for 40% of all clean energy and climate benefits to go to “historically disadvantaged communities” in Maryland. We’re running out of time to act on climate, friend, which is exactly why we need to win this race — so we can put this plan into action and create a clean energy future for our state. Elevate, Wes | Wes Moore is a combat veteran, a former small business owner, and the former CEO of a leading non-profit. Wes believes no matter where you start in life, you deserve an equal opportunity to succeed. He’s running to become Governor of Maryland and flip this state blue for the first time in 8 years. We’re already seeing the effects of climate change–like drought, extreme wildfires, deadly heatwaves, low snowpack, and more. We need to take action now if we want to prevent the climate crisis from becoming catastrophic. So what can we do to take action? One of the most powerful things we can do is vote. Vote for climate champions. Vote for a better future![](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44428701/341546578/395005035?usp=sharing&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ0MGU5ZjE1LTUxYzItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=m3OLtZXjDdyhVBYYJY_WpRTu9ebioDLG_eTQSr8O-z8=&emci=8fdb3884-f0c0-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=d40e9f15-51c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)That’s why, this Earth Day, we’re spreading the word about why it’s important to vote for the climate. In honor of Earth Day, will you join in our **Social Media Day of Action** and share one of our “I’m a Climate Voter” graphics on Facebook, Instagram, and/or Twitter? [**Check out our toolkit here!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44428705/341546580/-1156153911?usp=sharing&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ0MGU5ZjE1LTUxYzItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=m3OLtZXjDdyhVBYYJY_WpRTu9ebioDLG_eTQSr8O-z8=&emci=8fdb3884-f0c0-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=d40e9f15-51c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) Oregon’s future is on the line. Who we elect will either turn Oregon backwards and undo the progress we’ve made, or continue to move us forward. We simply don’t have time for anything but bold action. [**This Earth Day, will you join us in spreading the word about how important it is to vote for climate champions this upcoming election?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44428708/341546582/-1156153911?usp=sharing&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ0MGU5ZjE1LTUxYzItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=m3OLtZXjDdyhVBYYJY_WpRTu9ebioDLG_eTQSr8O-z8=&emci=8fdb3884-f0c0-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=d40e9f15-51c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) The primary is right around the corner on May 17th, and there’s a lot at stake. clean_body: | | | | ---|--- | | Happy Earth Day, Peter, A few weeks ago, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) released a new climate report. The findings? We need to phase out fossil fuels immediately. We’re already seeing the effects of climate change–like drought, extreme wildfires, deadly heatwaves, low snowpack, and more. We need to take action now if we want to prevent the climate crisis from becoming catastrophic. So what can we do to take action? One of the most powerful things we can do is vote. Vote for climate champions. Vote for a better futureThat’s why, this Earth Day, we’re spreading the word about why it’s important to vote for the climate. In honor of Earth Day, will you join in our Social Media Day of Action and share one of our “I’m a Climate Voter” graphics on Facebook, Instagram, and/or Twitter? Oregon’s future is on the line. Who we elect will either turn Oregon backwards and undo the progress we’ve made, or continue to move us forward. We simply don’t have time for anything but bold action. The primary is right around the corner on May 17th, and there’s a lot at stake. Thank you for taking action, Francesca Varela Communications Coordinator, OLCV P.S. This Social Media Day of Action is part of Earth Week! body:
Hi, Derek, it’s Michigan state Senator Mallory McMorrow.
You may have seen me online or on TV this week. That’s because on Tuesday, after reading a fundraising email sent by a Republican colleague where I was accused of wanting to “groom and sexualize children” for defending LGBTQ+ rights, I took to the Michigan Senate floor to defend myself and the marginalized communities Republicans love attacking :
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvadlcc?refcode=20220422_CGVA_DLCC [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvadlcc?refcode=20220422_CGVA_DLCC]
I've had people reach out to thank me for speaking out, but this isn't about me , Derek. It's about us – and how if enough of us come together, speak out, and take action to hold Republicans accountable for their hollow, hateful scheme, it will fail. Period.
As a Michigan state Senator, I’ve seen just how far state Republicans are willing to go to pass their backward agenda , and I know that if we can elect more Democrats to our statehouses, we can stop them.
Will you stand with me and chip in a $25 split donation to the DLCC and the CommonGood? Your support will go right to work electing more Democrats to state legislatures and in races around the country who will fight for our values and stand up against Republicans’ hateful agenda. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvadlcc?refcode=20220422_CGVA_DLCC]

Derek, hate will only win if people like us stand by and let it happen.
Throughout the country, state Republicans are waging war on our Democratic values, attacking the LGBTQ+ community, and passing legislation that blatantly denies the racism woven into our American story.
Electing Democrats to serve in state legislatures nationwide is the key to fighting back against state Republicans’ hateful crusade . But in Michigan, we’re already on edge – we have four special elections next month for critical seats in our state legislature. Electing Democrats to these seats is crucial to defending against a right-wing takeover.
We cannot stand by and let state Republicans continue their ruthless attacks – and we cannot let hate win.
Fighting back against hate starts with committed Democrats like you, [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvadlcc?refcode=20220422_CGVA_DLCC] Derek. Will you split a $25 donation today between DLCC and CommonGood to support state Democrats in this year’s midterm elections? This is a critical moment for Democratic state legislators and for Democrats in close races across the country, so we can’t back down now. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvadlcc?refcode=20220422_CGVA_DLCC]
Together,
Mallory McMorrow

subject: We have a long way to go

body:
I continue to advocate for historic investments in clean, renewable energy production, and an end to our dependence on tyrant-controlled oil.
#
Peter,
It’s Earth Day, so I wanted to take a few minutes to write to you about climate change and my advocacy to protect our planet.
It’s important that we discuss how little time there is left to prevent climate catastrophe. Extreme weather events are happening more frequently, and they continue getting worse.
Heatwaves, droughts, and wildfires in the West, heavy rain and flooding in the Midwest, record cold temperatures in Texas, and more frequent hurricanes in the South and East — _this will be our new normal unless we ACT._
It will only get worse if we don’t immediately pass legislation to invest in bold solutions to the climate crisis. **Will you join me in this fight, Peter?**
[**Contribute $3 to support my advocacy to address the climate crisis. We have no time left to wait, and we must go big if we’re going to meet this crisis head on.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12838?refcode=em20220422-1206&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1206%2E420207%2EC83gbj)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12838?refcode=em20220422-1206&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=1206%2E420207%2EC83gbj)**
Just look at these two recent headlines on how pressing the crisis is.
_Yahoo News_ : "IPCC: Window to avert catastrophic climate change is quickly closing"
_New York Times_ : "Stopping Climate Change is Doable, But Time is Short, U.N. Panel Warns"
We cannot ignore the dangerous and deadly effects of climate change. It's time to make meaningful investments into climate action and save our planet right now.
That’s why I continue to advocate for historic investments in clean, renewable energy production, and an end to our dependence on tyrant-controlled oil. It’s why I introduced the Climate Resilience Workforce Act to invest in a skilled workforce capable of responding to and preparing for the destructive impacts of climate-fueled extreme weather.
And it’s why I applaud action by President Biden this week to restore federal regulations requiring rigorous environmental review for major infrastructure projects.
We have a long way to go to end our reliance on fossil fuels, scale up clean renewable energy, and transform our society into one ready to stop climate change.
[**We can only make these bold changes together, Peter. Can you chip in $3 today to fuel my work to pass legislation and advocate for action to avert climate catastrophe?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12838?refcode=em20220422-1206&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1206%2E420207%2EC83gbj)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/12838?refcode=em20220422-1206&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=1206%2E420207%2EC83gbj)**
Thank you so much for all that you do to push for big, bold change to protect our planet.
In solidarity,
Pramila

#### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq**
Watching this year's Indiana primary race is like observing a sinking ship. It's just sad...almost embarrassing. I've spoken with so many of you since the catastrophe with the Indiana Election Commission and I understand your decision not to participate in the primaries because you feel your right to choose the best candidate was stripped from you.
However, I will never encourage you not to participate in what is your civic duty and responsibility. I remind you it took centuries of struggle to establish the right to vote in general for all U.S. citizens over the age of 18. We must never forget the blood, sweat, and tears that went into creating this freedom.

Now, comes the test. It is saddening to see your favorite candidate deleted from a race so easily after so much hard work and investment, but I assure you, I am still here, and because of you...stronger than ever!

When the headlines can't seem to get it right, we must be our own voice. When we feel abandoned, we must yet lift our heads high. When the way has not been made for us, we must create our own. We must continue to stand for what is right even when we don't see it around us.

Now, here's what I need you to do right now:
* Forward this message to nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform them that I meant what I said in the beginning when I said I would run for the Senate until **_we_** all won!
* Commit to my campaign now by [donating $9](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=22b2dab5a0&e=a49cb82bb3) or more to keep this true grassroots campaign moving.
* [Subscribe and follow me on social media](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=a39119d824&e=a49cb82bb3) where I'm active and live often. Share a post or two!

Visit [haneefahkhaaliq.org](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=13ac226af7&e=a49cb82bb3), view my 33 national policies and agendas, and become a volunteer today! I am Indiana. You are Indiana. Together, we are Indiana!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate
2022

Friend,
The disturbing increase of carjackings in Prince George’s County is unacceptable. Violence plagues our streets and we must do more. According to published reports, in the first 3 months of this year there was a 42% spike in carjackings. This is not ok. As Prince George’s County Council Member At-Large Mel Franklin said, “This crisis is a State of Emergency.”
If we’re going to talk about jobs, let’s also talk about the need to be able to get to work safely. If we’re talking about education, let’s also talk about looking at crime holistically and addressing the root causes. If we’re going to talk about housing, let’s talk about neighborhood safety.
As County Executive, my Transforming Neighborhood Initiative helped reduce violent crime by 58%. This is doable, and we MUST do it.
If this is the type of leadership you think Maryland deserves, please consider donating to my campaign today. This is how we fight for a better future. [http://secure.ngpvan.com/t_OakHAu1Eyexxm3ZVTwZw2]

f Friend,

This weekend, our team is wrapping up Week 3 of what
I’m calling the “Closing Argument State Tour.” We have 32 more days in
the “court of public opinion” before the jury makes a decision. When
Georgia voters go to the polls, with your continued help, we will
prevail. Why?

I am the most qualified to defeat Raphael Warnock. I
have a conservative record of service, decision making, and voting, not
a record with police departments in Texas.

I am the most qualified
to go to work immediately for Georgia. No on the job training pause.
The ideas I speak about are mine, not out of state consultants'.

I
know Georgia, and Georgia knows me. When cooking onion rings in Vidalia
today, I know it’s pronounced “V-EYE-DAY-lia,” not “V-Dahl-lia.”

For
32 days, I’m asking you to continue to give of your time and treasure.
Loan your reputation to me as you speak to your friends at church, your
family members across the state, and your employees. We know that 93%
of voters will “confirm” their vote with someone else before they cast
it.

Stand strong with me. Speak out. Order more yard signs and
bumper stickers. Share our social media posts. Phone bank your
contacts. Inspire and challenge your friends to vote — and share our
Voter Resources page with them.

Know that my schedule is relentless.
I’m blessed folks are asking us to come everywhere. Here’s this

My good friend Bill Edwards

Battle Lumber Company Hand Shake with

Cooking and serving V-EYE-DAY-lia Onion

Keynoting Leadership Georgia
Spring Program - Vidalia

Saturday

Barrow Co GOP Breakfast -
Winder

Clarksville

Cobb County Community BBQ with my friend Chad Williams -
Smyrna

Sunday

My friend Ashford Schwall’s Fulton Brunch Bunch -
Buckhead

Press on everybody! We’re blessed with the best team and
best message. I’m working daily to restore Georgia's positive influence
in the U.S. Senate.

God Bless,

name: Team Benson
subject: The stakes of this convention
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Before we hear who the Michigan GOP endorses for secretary of state (and we’re pretty sure we know who it’s going to be) we need to break down what’s at stake on Saturday.

In 2020, Jocelyn presided over the safest, most-secure election in Michigan history. She did so by modernizing the voter registration system, providing secure drop boxes for communities across the state, and recruiting tens of thousands of new election workers. She made sure every voter could exercise their right to cast an absentee ballot and in-person voter registration on Election Day. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=042222]

To put it plainly, she made voting easy and secure for Michigan voters.
Now imagine a world where every single piece of that work is undone.

Friend, what you’re imagining is the nightmare that we’ll be facing with Kristina Karamo. Do you know what she was doing on Election Day in 2022? She showed up in person to interfere with the absentee ballot counting process. She caused so much commotion that she caught the eye of Donald Trump himself.

If she was willing to actively overturn the will of Michigan voters as an anonymous citizen, imagine what she could do if she had an ounce of power.
The GOP convention is happening tomorrow and all signs point to Karamo being the nominee. So, we’re looking at a national voting rights expert like Jocelyn Benson running against someone who supports the Big Lie. A key figure in protecting democracy versus someone appealing to QAnon for support.

As extreme as these differences may seem, they’re very real. The results of this particular race will play out over years to come. Will Michigan continue to lead the country as a national model for election security or will Michigan be the state where a MAGA-endorsed official candidate can be confident that non-existent votes will be found ?

Sure, we expect the GOP to say some crazy things but let’s not lose sight of this: the stakes are high. And we cannot let Karamo make progress toward her version of election integrity.

Join thousands of allies across this state and support Jocelyn’s campaign today.

Support >>https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=042222]
-Team Benson

I’m going to be honest. When I first launched my campaign, I dreaded call time. But I knew it was something that was required of me as a congressional candidate. As I started these call times and discussed critical issues impacting the lives, families, and communities of our district, I realized this is what democracy is all about.
Free and fair elections are the fundamental ideals of our American democracy, and catering to the special interests of big corporations must end. I am adamant about running a grassroots campaign and not accepting corporate PAC donations because we need to take big money out of politics.
Therefore, I wanted to reach out to you and ask if you could make a contribution to my campaign. One small donation from you would significantly impact my ability to give Virginia’s 8th constituents a spirited voice at the Capitol. From affordable housing to the environment and veterans rights, I believe this is the time to usher in a new era of leadership. Will you help elect the first Latina-Indian American woman ever to lead Virginia's 8th? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/victoria-for-congress?refcode=calltime]

#### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq**
Watching this year's Indiana primary race is like observing a sinking ship. It's just sad...almost embarrassing. I've spoken with so many of you since the catastrophe with the Indiana Election Commission and I understand your decision not to participate in the primaries because you feel your right to choose the best candidate was stripped from you.
However, I will never encourage you not to participate in what is your civic duty and responsibility. I remind you it took centuries of struggle to establish the right to vote in general for all U.S. citizens **_18 years or older_.** We must never forget the blood, sweat, and tears that went into creating this freedom.

Now, comes the test. It is saddening to see your favorite candidate deleted from a race so easily after so much hard work and investment, but I assure you, I am still here, and because of you...stronger than ever!

When the headlines can't seem to get it right, we must be our own voice. When we feel abandoned, we must yet lift our heads high. When the way has not been made for us, we must create our own. We must continue to stand for what is right even when we don't see it around us.

Now, here's what I need you to do right now:
* Forward this message to nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform them that I meant what I said in the beginning when I said I would run for the Senate until **_we_** all won!

Hi friends, Today is Earth Day, a day to reflect on the importance of taking care of the place we all share and call home. We all share the responsibility to leave a better world for our kids, but unchecked pollution from fossil fuels and mega-corporations has put the health and future of our children at risk. Ninety-nine percent of scientists, NASA, and the Department of Defense all agree that climate change is a threat – and we’re already seeing its impact in the forms of increasingly severe weather, drought, and wildfires, which is already devastating our communities in New Mexico. **Unfortunately, our current representative only seems to care about corporate profits, out-of-state CEOs, and Wall Street executives.** She has shown no interest in addressing climate change, protecting our wildlife and natural resources, or conserving our public lands. That’s a major reason why I’m running for Congress in NM-02: to give our district a conservation champion in Congress who will work to capitalize on clean energy like wind and solar, take bold action to mitigate the impacts of climate change, protect our public lands, address water scarcity and drought, and continue to grow our economy by electrifying our homes, cars, and businesses. I’ve spent a major part of my career in this fight, helping to stop the Gila River diversion, designating new national monuments across our state, fighting for access to the outdoors for our underserved youth, and holding polluters accountable. **There’s a good reason why I’ve been endorsed by the League of Conservation Voters Action Fund, New Mexico Wild Action Fund, The Next 50, and the National Wildlife Federation Action Fund: I will fight for you and the future of our planet.** **[But in order to do so, I need to unseat far-right Republican Yvette Herrell at the ballot box this November. clean_body: | = Hi friends, Today is Earth Day, a day to reflect on the importance of taking care of the place we all share and call home. We all share the responsibility to leave a better world for our kids, but unchecked pollution from fossil fuels and mega-corporations has put the health and future of our children at risk. Ninety-nine percent of scientists, NASA, and the Department of Defense all agree that climate change is a threat – and we’re already seeing its impact in the forms of increasingly severe weather, drought, and wildfires, which is already devastating our communities in New Mexico. Unfortunately, our current representative only seems to care about corporate profits, out-of-state CEOs, and Wall Street executives. She has shown no interest in addressing climate change, protecting our wildlife and natural resources, or conserving our public lands. That’s a major reason why I’m running for Congress in NM-02: to give our district a conservation champion in Congress who will work to capitalize on clean energy like wind and solar, take bold action to mitigate the impacts of climate change, protect our public lands, address water scarcity and drought, and continue to grow our economy by electrifying our homes, cars, and businesses. I’ve spent a major part of my career in this fight, helping to stop the Gila River diversion, designating new national monuments across our state, fighting for access to the outdoors for our underserved youth, and holding polluters accountable. subject: A better future is possible
body:
