Derek Marshall is running in California's newly-created 23rd Congressional District, against incumbent Jay Obernolte, not Kevin McCarthy, who represents the former 23rd district. You may be receiving these emails because you've previously indicated you support progressive and Democratic candidates. Emails are the best way we update our supporters, but y ou can always unsubscribe: https://email.ngpvan.com/unsubscribeUnique/b6c65576-c4c1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a/8f68e4a3-5dc2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZjY4ZTRhMy01ZGMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nnM7YrtUyr5nz5eUad9OUGwXOE2rMzb_bIrwu9SptTg=&id=124407521 here.
Peter,
If there’s one thing that defines my candidacy, it’s my vocal support for a Green New Deal. It’s my number one priority. So this Earth Day, let me tell you why.
My district is on the frontlines of the climate crisis. We wake up to some of the hottest days on record. We watch as drought sucks our bodies of water dry. We prepare for the worst, knowing wildfires sweep through more and more these days.
The climate crisis is not abstract to us, it’s our daily reality. Because jobs are so far and few between in this district, many people drive up to 2 hours just to get to work. We need the sustainable, good-paying jobs a Green New Deal can provide.
But our Republican Congressman dismisses it as a Democratic pipe dream. I’m asking you to donate today to increase our chances of replacing an incumbent who is completely unprepared for the climate crisis. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dm-april?refcode=4-22&amount=38]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
Express Donate: $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dm-april?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=4-22_express_lane_5]
Express Donate: $15 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dm-april?express_lane=true&amount=15&refcode=4-22_express_lane_15]
Express Donate: $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dm-april?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=4-22_express_lane_25]
Express Donate: $38 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dm-april?express_lane=true&amount=38&refcode=4-22_express_lane_38]
Express Donate: Other [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dm-april?express_lane_other=true&refcode=4-22_express_lane_other]
Or, maximize your impact and make your donation monthly. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dm-april?refcode=4-22&recurring=1]
Did you know that our federal government pays out $20 billion every year to the fossil fuel industry? And when these corporations receive their massive payouts, they turn around and spend those billions influencing our elections. I never have, and never will, accept money from the fossil fuel industry, or any corporations for that matter.
When I’m in Congress, I will never forget the people who sent me there, constituents whose lives and livelihoods are on the line thanks to climate change. Our entire future is at stake. That’s why I need your support to get to Congress, so we can actually do something about it. Can I count on your donation today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dm-april?refcode=4-22&amount=38]
In solidarity,
Derek Marshall
Candidate for U.S. Congress, CA-23

subject: This campaign just got a lot bigger, but we're still $2,187 short of our weekly goal.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ben Smilowitz for Congress
body:
Grassroots campaigns are only as strong as the support they receive! |
---
| | Dear Peter

I’m sure you know by now, but we have a new Congressional map. I’m happy to have thousands of new friends, but to be honest, District 6 just got a lot bigger – and this campaign just got a lot more expensive.

As it stands, we are trying to raise another $2,187 by the end of the week so we can grow our campaign into the new areas of District 6 and bring in new supporters. That’s why I’m reaching out to you right now. Can you give $5, $10, $25, or anything at all today? Here’s a link to chip in: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ben-smilowitz-for-congress-1](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=6853bbc220&e=0faa9de128)**

Unlike our current Congressman, I’m not a millionaire. I started a nonprofit after Hurricane Katrina to improve accountability in disaster relief, not to get rich. This is a people-powered, grassroots campaign, and we’ve come this far because of you.

But we have work to do.

I know you believe, like I do, that we need immediate action to address the climate crisis and preserve our democracy, and that now is the time to expand access to quality and affordable healthcare and save Social Security.

And – needless to say – most of our current elected leaders are not doing enough.

But the new District 6 map means I have thousands of new voters across Frederick and Montgomery counties. Ideally, I’d go knock on every door and shake hands with every voter but, to be honest, much of the new district is simply not walkable. This means investing in a solid mail and phone program, and building a strong field operation.

With you, I know we can build the kind of grassroots campaign that will win July’s primary, send the big-money incumbent packing, and make sure your voice is heard in Congress.

Thank you for everything you’ve done and continue to do for this campaign. I couldn’t do this without you.

Ben

and to try to help himself stay in leadership in the Republican Party.

inconsequential conversation about the upcoming midterms, the type of

Here is a picture of the Rogue River, one of the rivers I'm working to protect from overdevelopment: [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44435652/341576217/-2044921950?refcode=2022-04-22-earth-day&recurring=0&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=589a0dd0-62c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ODlhMGRkMC02MmMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RLHIN8qt7gq55qi1M_Hw1Ca2yx1oprKIGjgVavLQhu0=) On this Earth Day, let's recommit to the fight to be good stewards of our environment. body:
Before we hear who the Michigan GOP endorses for secretary of state (and we’re pretty sure we know who it’s going to be) we need to break down what’s at stake on Saturday.

In 2020, Jocelyn presided over the safest, most-secure election in Michigan history. She did so by modernizing the voter registration system, providing secure drop boxes for communities across the state, and recruiting tens of thousands of new election workers. She made sure every voter could exercise their right to cast an absentee ballot and in-person voter registration on Election Day. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=042222]

To put it plainly, she made voting easy and secure for Michigan voters.
Now imagine a world where every single piece of that work is undone.

Friend, what you’re imagining is the nightmare that we’ll be facing with Kristina Karamo. Do you know what she was doing on Election Day in 2020? She showed up in person to interfere with the absentee ballot counting process. She caused so much commotion that she caught the eye of Donald Trump himself.

If she was willing to actively overturn the will of Michigan voters as an anonymous citizen, imagine what she could do if she had an ounce of power.
The GOP convention is happening tomorrow and all signs point to Karamo being the nominee. So, we’re looking at a national voting rights expert like Jocelyn Benson running against someone who supports the Big Lie. A key figure in protecting democracy versus someone appealing to QAnon for support.

As extreme as these differences may seem, they’re very real. The results of this particular race will play out over years to come. Will Michigan continue to lead the country as a national model for election security or will Michigan be the state where a MAGA-endorsed official candidate can be confident that non-existent votes will be found ?

Sure, we expect the GOP to say some crazy things but let’s not lose sight of this: the stakes are high. And we cannot let Karamo make progress toward her version of election integrity.

Join thousands of allies across this state and support Jocelyn’s campaign today.

Support >>https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=042222]
-Team Benson

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44436657/341581141/-1015736156?refcode=EM_FR_220421Judiciary2_J_KP_90DO_7_NG_N_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc1NjVhMzA2LTY2YzItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=QwtX477rknXTJVfmxQqfeTIPOZdielDOVDdC5egZCMo=)
| Fellow activist,

Yesterday, our team wrote to you about Pennsylvania’s appellate courts and the attempts to strip away our power to choose the judges and justices who sit on those benches. Today, I’d like to talk to you about another disturbing attack on our voting rights.

In 2020, Pennsylvania’s Supreme Court made a ruling that led to the implementation of ballot drop boxes which expanded voting access and improved voter turnout. That meant underrepresented and often ignored communities, including communities of color, came out and voted in record numbers.

The latest attack on our democracy would do away with ballot drop boxes entirely, only allowing ballots to be hand-delivered to the county board of elections directly or mailed in (requiring postage). It’s no coincidence this bill disproportionately impacts these same communities who are already left out of the democratic process.

**[Fellow activist, battles like this show how important it is that our government represents the values of all Pennsylvanians. Will you make a contribution now to help us expand the electorate and make sure everyone gets equal representation?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44436658/341581143/-1015736156?refcode=EM_FR_220421Judiciary2_J_KP_90DO_7_NG_N_L1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc1NjVhMzA2LTY2YzItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=QwtX477rknXTJVfmxQqfeTIPOZdielDOVDdC5egZCMo=)**
[DONATE NOW](https://click.everyaction.com/k/44436659/341581145/-1015736156?refcode=EM_FR_220421Judiciary2_J_KP_90DO_7_NG_N_B1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc1NjVhMzA2LTY2YzItZWMxMS05OTdlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=QwtX477rknXTJVfmxQqfeTIPOZdielDOVDdC5egZCMo=) Access to ballot drop boxes are just as essential as access to the ballot itself. Under this proposed law, even dense population centers like Philadelphia would have **only one drop-off point for over a million and a half people.**

This bill is a direct continuation of the attacks on our courts and the progress their rulings have made for voting rights. clean_body: Now the legislature wants to take us backwards = | Fellow activist, Yesterday, our team wrote to you about Pennsylvania’s appellate courts and the attempts to strip away our power to choose the judges and justices who sit on those benches. Today, I’d like to talk to you about another disturbing attack on our voting rights. In 2020, Pennsylvania’s Supreme Court made a ruling that led to the implementation of ballot drop boxes which expanded voting access and improved voter turnout. That meant underrepresented and often ignored communities, including communities of color, came out and voted in record numbers. The latest attack on our democracy would do away with ballot drop boxes entirely, only allowing ballots to be hand-delivered to the county board of elections directly or mailed in (requiring postage). It’s no coincidence this bill disproportionately impacts these same communities who are already left out of the democratic process. = = Access to ballot drop boxes are just as essential as access to the ballot itself. Under this proposed law, even dense population centers like Philadelphia would have only one drop-off point for over a million and a half people. This bill is a direct continuation of the attacks on our courts and the progress their rulings have made for voting rights. We must engage and empower new voters if we are to protect free and fair elections. When our democracy and our voting rights are under a sustained attack, our work is more vital than ever before. = = Katy Personette Director of Development and Policy The New Pennsylvania Project = | The New Pennsylvania Project was founded in May 2021 to expand Pennsylvania’s electorate, so it reflects the Commonwealth’s demographically changing population. In the next four years, NPP will engage and empower young residents and those living in underrepresented communities of color and immigrant communities. We will register them to vote, provide education about the issues that matter in their neighborhoods, and mobilize people to vote in every election. = PA ELECTION DATES : PRIMARY: May 17, 2022 GENERAL: November 8, 2022 || || || New Pennsylvania Project 717 Market Street #295 Lemoyne, PA 17043 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. to receive fewer emails from us. to stop receiving any fundraising emails from us. body:

#

Happy Earth Day, team. Our state is home to some beautiful places — lands that provide clean water and help fuel our economy. At the same time, with worsening wildfires and extreme drought, we’re seeing the impact of climate change firsthand. I’m taking on this issue in the Senate. Our historic, bipartisan _Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act_ secures Arizona’s water future, funds wildfire mitigation efforts, and helps develop clean energy technologies like electric vehicles, solar, and wind. On top of that, it invests in strengthening and expanding public transit, while making historic investments in removing harmful substances like lead and PFAS from our water pipes. **This legislation makes real strides to ensure Arizonans have clean water to drink and clean air to breathe, and I’m proud we got it over the finish line.** [**So this Earth Day, please add your name to show your support for our work to secure Arizona’s water future and develop clean energy technology.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44437286/341582683/-384844875?refcode=AU_KLS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220422_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84OTMxNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWJiODY1MS02NmMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wl983rhKCzZtwoi4-OSda2vp1b7RPxTXIiBi-p7YTt8=&emci=07fde8a4-9ec1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a9bb8651-66c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2415496) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44437289/341582686/-384844875?refcode=AU_KLS_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20220422_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84OTMxNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWJiODY1MS02NmMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wl983rhKCzZtwoi4-OSda2vp1b7RPxTXIiBi-p7YTt8=&emci=07fde8a4-9ec1-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=a9bb8651-66c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2415496)

| Dear Fellow Patriot,
In light of the [Edgewater City Council](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010Pj3oFtlDSv2yLr31eM5EWXue--a-mJ9d5z5T3u9iPuDQ6ipIWAgVypTF251uzFmGqs_NCLWEdc68o8AwkDSQoHAtD0uCQ44Vi2C8GQTeFdLlQJEZ6irWPvT6brK1DFLiXLZ0XsfLtARZ1Lul3Dy7ukBsZwoUQvbCi3emFhfnVMmmNK8Grm5A6m-pJ9e-Ola6R_XHrwFRT7BUFR4Mr_MQOk88q0YlGxF&c=GbOFxYJGBNmBd7VFnhVqbDabFOYyqQ2RLhy1_dYo2OOjMX9oXAYcmA==&ch=4P6z3HtK9yHnmH1BSXcZgwZ3nClxOLcxD29IpLhRq0ox8XDMjtuqcg==) recently discussing how they may be empowered as local government to regulate the use of firearms with the passage of [Colorado SB21-256](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010Pj3oFtlDSv2yLr31eM5EWXue--a-mJ9d5z5T3u9iPuDQ6ipIWAgVypTF251uzFmK_mjneMkv9OuTk9QFmJQtZDoLEh8elbgBppOMGn3vJFXO--0RxGCuYvt39ZXu1fkrUkYk9OYQzc4EoC4-jYa9Kdslh4b6ZldF4tkZsL_kEo=&c=GbOFxYJGBNmBd7VFnhVqbDabFOYyqQ2RLhy1_dYo2OOjMX9oXAYcmA==&ch=4P6z3HtK9yHnmH1BSXcZgwZ3nClxOLcxD29IpLhRq0ox8XDMjtuqcg==), I thought I would highlight [10 reasons](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010Pj3oFtlDSv2yLr31eM5EWXue--a-mJ9d5z5T3u9iPuDQ6ipIWAgVypTF251uzFmo1BN0bTKH6vIEBDWVlUwzuXzfW0Wxa8CrqjXR7sjZcHPcyFLzPV3A3OgzPmJ0ayLq1Zw04ogqIicfji-1AGL3-awXp7EeMH3u6R4jLSiemBbKWYkKzvCuSl-meGi3uhksBUJeGTPJlAE3re4cbwdTDpQ1Iw_qk85e0D6CJ31LUj8TzMIxuL5cV3ODjg-jrBZG9KRZT1ktas=&c=GbOFxYJGBNmBd7VFnhVqbDabFOYyqQ2RLhy1_dYo2OOjMX9oXAYcmA==&ch=4P6z3HtK9yHnmH1BSXcZgwZ3nClxOLcxD29IpLhRq0ox8XDMjtuqcg==) why women can celebrate the importance of their 2nd Amendment rights.
Last month women across the country lawfully exercised their 2nd Amendment rights in a variety of challenging circumstances ranging from home invasions, domestic violence, being assaulted on the job, to car jackings. [Here's 10 instances](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010Pj3oFtlDSv2yLr31eM5EWXue--a-mJ9d5z5T3u9iPuDQ6ipIWAgVypTF251uzFmo1BN0bTKH6vIEBDWVlUwzuXzfW0Wxa8CrqjXR7sjZcHPcyFLzPV3A3OgzPmJ0ayLq1Zw04ogqIicfji-1AGL3-awXp7EeMH3u6R4jLSiemBbKWYkKzvCuSl-meGi3uhksBUJeGTPJlAE3re4cbwdTDpQ1Iw_qk85e0D6CJ31LUj8TzMIxuL5cV3ODjg-jrBZG9KRZT1ktas=&c=GbOFxYJGBNmBd7VFnhVqbDabFOYyqQ2RLhy1_dYo2OOjMX9oXAYcmA==&ch=4P6z3HtK9yHnmH1BSXcZgwZ3nClxOLcxD29IpLhRq0ox8XDMjtuqcg==) of women exercising that Constitutional right which saved their lives, and those of their loved ones, in some cases.
---
| [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010Pj3oFtlDSv2yLr31eM5EWXue--a-mJ9d5z5T3u9iPuDQ6ipIWAgVypTF251uzFmc12q_unPHeJ1BJdUFz3BI2pCUZlzPR41Sf0G_ojMS_r1FrBMR62yO4bWZwh8bhevTdxCUujMUAGHOUeX9PV7AFsCCynuIJ3ZABkKp1-2SkP4mWH-mOgD69U1j23B_nlAOcKuVA9GOAQ=&c=GbOFxYJGBNmBd7VFnhVqbDabFOYyqQ2RLhy1_dYo2OOjMX9oXAYcmA==&ch=4P6z3HtK9yHnmH1BSXcZgwZ3nClxOLcxD29IpLhRq0ox8XDMjtuqcg==)

|
As our 2nd Amendment rights continue to come under assault at the state and federal level, those who believe that gun regulation is an answer to stemming the surge of crime are jumping at the opportunity to limit one of our most foundational rights as an American.
As your next Congresswoman, I will always stand against any attempt to infringe the 2nd Amendment rights of law-abiding citizens!
I urge every 2nd Amendment supporter to continue the good fight by standing up for Constitutional rights, electing Conservative candidates at the local, state, and federal level, and remaining vigilant about attempts to curtail our God-given ability to protect our lives and those we love!
Together we will obtain a Red Wave victory in 2022, and put a stop to the obscene violation of our rights by the Radical Left agenda.

subject: Democrats' worst nightmare

body:
-
I’m putting this at the TOP of your inbox.
| |
---
| | [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0402&recruiter_id=62410&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0402&n=1)
---
| Peter, There's nothing Democrats fear more than outspoken Black conservatives exposing their Liberal LIES about "racist" conservatives to Black voters... ...but a popular Black, Christian conservative, _Army combat veteran, and successful businessman_ like John James **running for Congress** is the **Democrats' worst nightmare**. **[I'm hoping you'll endorse John James for the U.S. House of Representatives, but first let me explain why the Democrats are so terrified of him.](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0402&recruiter_id=62410&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0402&n=2)** The Democrats are gearing up for war, and they fully expect to maintain control of the House this election. **But behind the scenes,_they're terrified_ that John James is about to thwart their entire takeover plot.** And they have good reason to be afraid. | [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0402&recruiter_id=62410&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0402&n=3)
---
##### Captain John James will be the next U.S. Congressman from Michigan, but only with your help.
After all, they saw first-hand in previous elections what John is capable of - _watching in horror as he soared from a 21-point deficit to just 7 points within a few short months._
Shocked that their supposedly _"unbeatable"_ Senator was on the verge of losing to a _"nobody"_ political outsider...
...the panicked Democrats were forced to dump **over $15 million** into slowing down John's relentless surge just enough for well-known, deep-pocketed, and entrenched Democrat Senator Debbie Stabenow to narrowly squeak past.
# John James won more votes (1.9 million) than ANY Republican in Michigan in over a decade.
The Democrats are terrified because they know that if John can nearly topple one of the most powerful Democrats in the U.S. Senate...
**...then they don't stand a chance against John James this election!**
John is a successful, articulate, and intelligent Black conservative whose impeccable character is impossible for liberals to deface with slander and lies.
He's a West Point graduate, Ranger-qualified aviation officer, and retired Army Captain who served with distinction while leading two Apache helicopter platoons in Iraq.
He's also a successful businessman, having quadrupled his company's revenue and added 100 new employees in his first 5 years as President.
And through each step of his journey, John has led with courage, conviction, and a servant-first mentality that comes from his Christian faith.
[](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0402&recruiter_id=62410&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0402&n=4)
---
##### "I am a conservative who happens to be black. I'm in the Republican Party because the platform most aligns with my values. I am pro-life. I am pro-Second Amendment. I am pro-family. I am pro-business."
John calls himself an _"unapologetic Christian, pro-life, pro-business, pro-Second Amendment, conservative outsider"_ but Fox News and others are calling him _**"The future of the GOP."**_
**[And if this isn't enough to make you want to help send John James to the U.S. House of Representatives...](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0402&recruiter_id=62410&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0402&n=5)**
**...let me tell you what scares the Democrats most about John James.**
**John is on a mission to reclaim Black voters by exposing the Liberal LIE that conservatives like you and me are racists.**
He's opening their eyes to the _"Democratic brand of dependency that's being peddled"_ by unmasking Democrats as opportunistic, self-serving politicians who prey on Blacks with lies, empty promises, and failed policies.
And John's damning critiques of the Democrat Party and honest outreach to the Black Community are reclaiming Black voters to the Republican Party.
**John James is a serious threat to the Democrat Party, and they know it!**
_"He's SPECTACULAR. Rarely have I seen a candidate with such great potential. West Point graduate, successful businessman, and an African American leader...**He will be a star.** "_
-President Donald Trump
---
**To say the Democrats are panicking would be an understatement.**
They know John can reclaim enough Black voters to convert Michigan from a long-standing Democrat stronghold into the newest "red state."
And they know that winning a U.S. Congressional race will catapult John to national stardom, guaranteeing that millions of Black voters across America will hear his powerful message and begin fleeing the Democrat Party.
Once elected, Congressman John James will work tirelessly to:
* **EXPOSE** the Liberal Lies to the entire nation
* **RECLAIM** Black voters to the Republican Party
* **END** the Democrats' death-grip on the Black Community

**And Democrats know that if they lose just 12% of the Black vote, it'll be impossible for them to ever win another election.**
# That's why Democrats are terrified of John James and WILL STOP AT NOTHING TO SHUT HIM UP
**[That’s why I pray you'll also make an urgent, recurring donation of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more to help John FIGHT BACK against the Democrats' vicious attacks!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0402&recruiter_id=62410&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0402&n=6)**
BAMPAC Action Fund played an ACTIVE roll helping John James shrink the margin between him and his opponent in the previous election.
With your help, we were able to place billboards in key areas throughout Michigan, like the one you see here:
[](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0402&recruiter_id=62410&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0402&n=7)
---
We also ran radio ads in 3 of the largest black communities in Michigan and reached voters through online video ads in 10 key Michigan counties.
These online video ads were targeted towards Black Americans who’d voted in 2 of the last 4 elections up to that point.
And with your help... _we’ll do it again!_
John James really is _**"the future Republicans have been waiting for,"**_ but that future may never arrive without your committed support.
The Democrats are desperate to STOP John from taking this critical Congressional seat and END his campaign to recruit Black voters to the Republican Party.
And make no mistake about it: the future of our shared conservative values depends on our ability to reclaim Black voters from the Democrats.
**[That’s why your _monthly_ gift of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more is so critical now more than ever!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0402&recruiter_id=62410&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0402&n=8)**
Real change takes time and commitment, and I know that you’re in this fight for the long-haul.
I know you won’t allow our conservative values to fall to the wayside by failing to build a conservative future.
That’s why I’m counting on your help TODAY.
**[So please help defend John James from Democrat attacks and DESTROY the liberal lies with your _monthly_ gift of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more TODAY!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0402&recruiter_id=62410&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0402&n=9)**
Thank you, and God Bless.
| [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0402&recruiter_id=62410&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0402&n=10)
---
_For America,_ |
---
**Alvin Williams**
President & CEO
BAMPAC, BAMPAC Action Fund
[DONATE](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0402&recruiter_id=62410&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0402&n=11)

The reality is, over the past six decades, fundamental issues have gone without any serious efforts to fix them, particularly water security and sustainable infrastructure.

clean_body: | | I’m from a 4th-generation farming family. I was raised to value the Earth and all it provides. But in my lifetime alone, families like mine and others across Washington have seen drastic changes in our environment that impact our everyday lives. The reality is, over the past six decades, fundamental issues have gone without any serious efforts to fix them, particularly water security and sustainable infrastructure. We can’t ignore the damages of the climate crisis already taking a toll on our communities. It’s time we take responsibility for protecting our planet for future generations. | | We must build resiliency into our economy by facing up to the fact our climate is changing. The climate crisis isn’t going away, so we must do everything we can to mitigate damages and adjust to a new way of life. Everyday, hardworking Washingtonians – like the family I come from – are at the forefront of this crisis. Our district already faces annual drought that could devastate businesses and the livelihoods of the thousands of families they support. Unfortunately, right now we’re being represented by a climate denier who refuses to acknowledge the impact of climate change. I’m committed to bringing the voices of working families to Congress, but our work begins long before I get there. Let’s make our voices heard. Thanks for standing with us. name: Herschel Walker
subject: “Any old Black person will do.”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece. | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60203672:JbpbNwoN9:m:1:3253819041:D37221CCDBEE22E350931F111D3F23C3:r)

---
Peter,

I have to admit - I hadn't heard of the far-left publication called _The Nation_ before last week. Now, I'll never forget it.

They published an attack piece against me - based on the color of my skin - that is beyond ridiculous and insulting.

While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece.

There are a lot of nasty things said about me in this article simply because I'm a Black Republican. Like this:

"Herschel Walker, the football star turned Georgia Senate candidate, is an animated caricature of a Black person drawn by white conservatives."
Or maybe this line:

"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."
It's shameful.

But the writer doesn't just take aim at me. He questions the support from folks like you, too:

"Most white people in the South vote 'R' like their entire white supremacist project depends on it."
Peter, I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign. However, can you imagine the reaction from the mainstream media if these things had been said about a Black Democrat? The outrage! There would be calls for the writer to be fired and the publication cancelled.

But I'm not calling for a protest of the author or a boycott of the publication's advertisers. Nothing like that.

_**I think the best answer is to prove them wrong at the ballot box.**_

**[Will you join me in standing up to these racist attacks?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60203672:JbpbNwoN9:m:1:3253819041:D37221CCDBEE22E350931F111D3F23C3:r)**

**[Stand with Herschel against far-left attacks](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60203672:JbpbNwoN9:m:1:3253819041:D37221CCDBEE22E350931F111D3F23C3:r)**
[** Chip in $4 -> **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60203673:JbpbNwoN9:m:1:3253819041:D37221CCDBEE22E350931F111D3F23C3:r)
The media has been against our campaign since we launched last summer, but they have rarely been so brazen to say things as this:

"Georgia Republicans want Walker because he's Black and Warnock is Black, and they think they can defeat Warnock in November if they can shave just a little of the Black vote..."
I'm not **" any old Black person"** as the author of the article asserts. I'm Herschel Walker - a proud Georgian and a proud Republican - who has lived the American Dream and wants to secure that dream for the next generation of Americans from all walks of life.

_The best way to deal with racist tropes like these are to call them out, reject them, and prove them wrong._

I hope you'll stand with me against the political hit jobs that the far-left media keep throwing our way. **[Please support my campaign for the U.S. Senate today, and let's work together to unite this country instead of dividing it.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60203672:JbpbNwoN9:m:1:3253819041:D37221CCDBEE22E350931F111D3F23C3:r)**

Thank you,

I’ve spent my career fighting to protect public lands from greedy special interests. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44439702/341592317/1820125544?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDA3OTMwNC02ZGMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7fRRSyU8IbtIna-xnpcGDVKeM8tq84h76__0zsSW8tI=) Happy Earth Day, friend! Like most in Montana, I was raised with a deep connection to Mother Earth and our public lands. When I was younger, my best friend and I would ride the open lands that surrounded us on horseback with very few barriers or fences in our way. Our neighbors readily shared access to their lands. When my dad wasn’t out hunting, we’d all be outdoors -- camping, hiking, rafting, and fishing. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44439703/341592318/-10092236?refcode=em-4.22.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NDA3OTMwNC02ZGMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7fRRSyU8IbtIna-xnpcGDVKeM8tq84h76__0zsSW8tI=)
_Canoeing with my brother and stepdad_ Today is an important reminder that we have shared responsibility to protect our planet for future generations. This is an issue that transcends party politics -- it's important to our Native communities, conservationists, ranchers, and hunters alike. That unity is something we're all very proud of, and it's why we're so disturbed when politicians like Ryan Zinke exploit our public lands for corporate profits. During his time as Secretary of the Interior under Trump, Zinke oversaw the largest sell-off of public lands and oceans in American history. He ignored environmental protections, and opened up large swaths of land for fossil fuel exploitation. **Montana --_and our very planet_ \-- deserve better. We deserve a leader who will fight to protect our precious natural landscapes -- not sell them to the highest bidder. ** [**So, in honor of Earth Day, will you chip in $3 to my campaign today? I’ve spent my career fighting to protect Montana’s public lands from greedy special interests. We need your help.
Every campaign, including this one, involves a lot of moving parts – fundraising, organizing, operations, logistics, communications, political outreach, event planning, etc. It can get pretty complicated.
That said, our plan to win is based on a simple observation: when voters hear about Morgan, her campaign, and her vision for the future of Ohio, they’re compelled to get on board and cast their vote to send Morgan to the Senate.
The problem is that not enough people have heard about Morgan, and don’t know that they have a real choice in the May 3 Primary. Each member of Team Harper is doing their part to fix that – we’ve invested in TV ads and digital ads, and Morgan is traveling the state to make her case to voters one debate, club meeting, and press conference at a time. On the organizing team, we’ve organized volunteers across the state to knock doors and make phone calls to get people out to vote.
Morgan won’t stop putting in the work to win on May 3, but she can’t do it alone. For all of this hard work to pay off, we need to contact as many voters as possible to make sure that everyone who supports Morgan has a plan to vote, and we need everyone reading this email to help us do that. Here's how:
**Join our call team to help us make phone calls from home to voters across the state.** We’re going to be making calls to voters every day between now and May 3 to make sure they know everything they need to know about Morgan, how they can vote, and how they can help the campaign in other ways. When you sign up at the link below, you’ll get an email with next steps on how to get involved!
**[Sign up here to join our call team!](https://act.morganharper.org/signup/mh-website-volunteer/?source=em20220422&t=4&akid=986%2E90090%2ECh2JZT)**
Morgan, our staff, and volunteers like you have put in countless hours to help us get to where we are today. Thank you so much for your support, and I’m looking forward to working with you these next couple of weeks and celebrating with you on election night.
Thanks so much for all your help so far,
Dan

All of our organizers and volunteers need lit, paper, pens, clipboards, yard signs, and snacks to make our GOTV efforts as effective as they can be.**[If you can afford it, can you chip in a contribution of $11 to support our organizing team for the next 11 days until the primary?](https://act.morganharper.org/go/32295?t=5&akid=986%2E90090%2ECh2JZT)**

Happy Earth Day, friends!

From an early age, my mom taught me the lesson of leaving a place better than you found it. She used to pick up litter in our neighborhood, and now I carry a garbage picker and bucket in my car with me everywhere I go.
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44439709/341592326/1307566342?refcode=em22_220422_earthday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDc2NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MTA3OTMwNC02ZGMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SS2Ujfz_aHAk9lnmvJYht1xhKil6BrCIt6C2MHKPWTs=)

The existential threat of climate change can feel daunting and discouraging at times, but Earth Day is a perfect time to reflect on what difference you can make in your community, big or small. I've been proud of my work in the legislature, getting pollutants out of our drinking water and reducing single-use plastics, but there's so much more to be done.

**[Now I'm ready to do my part in Washington to protect our community and our planet. [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44439711/341592328/1307566342?refcode=em22_220422_earthday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDc2NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MTA3OTMwNC02ZGMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SS2Ujfz_aHAk9lnmvJYht1xhKil6BrCIt6C2MHKPWTs=)

**[Will you pitch in $5 or anything you can to give us the support we need to win and fight for our planet?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44439712/341592329/1307566342?refcode=em22_220422_earthday&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDc2NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MTA3OTMwNC02ZGMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SS2Ujfz_aHAk9lnmvJYht1xhKil6BrCIt6C2MHKPWTs=)**

[1]Beto O'Rourke

Today, we
want to take a step back and reflect on what’s happening at the very heart
of this campaign.

The fringe policies, corruption, and incompetence that we see in Texas
government today — at the border, on abortion, on guns, on schools, on the
electricity grid — are symptoms of a larger problem:

Greg Abbott has stopped listening to the people he was elected to serve.

Instead, he’s focused on the agendas of his corporate donors, on
preserving his own career, on catering to the most extreme voices in his
party, and on keeping himself in power regardless of the cost to the rest
of us.

It’s a small vision for such a big state. And it’s hurting the people of
Texas.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55643?refcode=ema20220422-186181&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=186181%2E444211%2EGwZ3-G ]Beto is running for governor to serve ALL of the people of Texas. If
you believe Texans deserve better than Abbott, will you pitch in
$3 today?

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55643?refcode=ema20220422-186181&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=186181%2E444211%2EGwZ3-G ]Contribute Now

Beto has already spent time in counties all across this state, and he’s
staying on the road to reach people everywhere in Texas.

Everywhere Beto goes, he listens to and learns from his fellow Texans. How
they think things are going, what they care about, what keeps them up at
night, what they dream for their kids and grandkids.

It turns out that in most communities, people have thought through the
solutions to the challenges before them. They don’t need someone to tell
them what’s best for them. They just need someone to show up, listen, be a
partner on the issues that matter most — better jobs, better schools,
expanded health care access, and safer, healthier communities — and then
take action.

The problem is that right now, Texans have a governor who’s actively
making their lives worse.

Higher grocery prices. Jacked-up utility bills. Skyrocketing property
taxes. Texans are paying the price for Abbott’s failed policies on a daily
basis — literally!

Across this state, Republicans, Democrats, and Independents can agree:
we’re losing the big, bold vision that used to define Texas, a Texas big
enough for all of us. Big enough for our dreams and big enough to make
them a reality. We’ve been offered something small, mean, and uninspiring
in its place.

But it doesn’t have to be this way. We can do better.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55643?refcode=ema20220422-186181&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=186181%2E444211%2EGwZ3-G ]The stakes couldn’t be higher in this race. Knowing that, will you join us and make your

body:
I was the only elected official in Western PA to oppose this.
#
Derek,
I have an important story I’d like to share with you.
Back in the 2000s, they wanted to build a four-lane interstate through Braddock, a Black and Brown community that was already suffering historically high asthma rates.
I called this “environmentally racist policy.” I am proud to be among the only elected officials in Western PA to oppose it.
Even today, it’s a constant struggle. Because communities like the one that I live in have different environmental standards + outcomes.
These experiences have helped shape one of my core values and a core value of this campaign: **Environmental justice for every American is critical.**
It's never lost on me that our future generations are going to feel the effects of what our national + state governments do today. On so many issues, from gun violence prevention, to education, to health care, to climate, our kids are quite literally depending on us to get this right.
Derek, know that if you send me to the U.S. Senate, my role as Senator would be informed by my 13 years as a mayor of a community that has faced many environmental injustice challenges and as a father who wants his children and his children’s (future) children to grow up in a better world than the one we have right now.
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47420?amount=5&refcode=em20220422-5495&t=1&akid=5495%2E434096%2EqLk83e)
_We love going to PA’s beautiful parks as a family_ ❤️
**My pledge to you is that I will fight for you, your family, and our planet each and every day in the Senate. clean_body: I was the only elected official in Western PA to oppose this. Derek, I have an important story I’d like to share with you. Back in the 2000s, they wanted to build a four-lane interstate through Braddock, a Black and Brown community that was already suffering historically high asthma rates. I called this “environmentally racist policy.” I am proud to be among the only elected officials in Western PA to oppose it. Even today, it’s a constant struggle. Because communities like the one that I live in have different environmental standards + outcomes. These experiences have helped shape one of my core values and a core value of this campaign: Environmental justice for every American is critical. It's never lost on me that our future generations are going to feel the effects of what our national + state governments do today. On so many issues, from gun violence prevention, to education, to health care, to climate, our kids are quite literally depending on us to get this right. Derek, know that if you send me to the U.S. Senate, my role as Senator would be informed by my 13 years as a mayor of a community that has faced many environmental injustice challenges and as a father who wants his children and his children’s (future) children to grow up in a better world than the one we have right now. We love going to PA’s beautiful parks as a family ❤️ My pledge to you is that I will fight for you, your family, and our planet each and every day in the Senate. But I need your support to get there. name: Charles Booker
subject: On this Earth Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

Today, April 22, 2022, marks the 52nd anniversary of Earth Day. While our
attention is drawn to other things right now, I wanted to take a moment to
celebrate this day and tell you more about why I support a Green New Deal.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220422?refcode=em20220422-other-1799&t=1001&refcode2=1799_346206_8CY9nX&akid=1799%2E346206%2E8CY9nX ]If you’re ready to pass a Green New Deal, will you chip in
$5 or whatever you can to help me get to the Senate so I can
help lead this fight? I’ll explain why this is so important to me.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220422?refcode=em20220422-1799&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&refcode2=1799_346206_8CY9nX&akid=1799%2E346206%2E8CY9nX ]Contribute $5 →

Our so-called leaders in Kentucky, like Mitch McConnell and Rand Paul,
don’t care to be honest with us about what the future holds. They
certainly don’t care to ensure that future generations will have a viable
planet to live on.

They’ve ignored the environmental effects on small farms that are fighting
every day to stay afloat.

They’ve ignored coal miners with Black Lung, and coal communities that
have lost vital revenue, and aren’t doing enough to make sure they aren’t
left behind.

And the longer they stay in office, the longer they’ll continue to ignore
us and what we need to survive, much less thrive.

I believe climate change is happening, and it is threatening the air we
breathe and the water we drink.

Implementing a Green New Deal is just the first step towards addressing
the climate crisis — but it’s an important step, and one we need to take
immediately.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220422?refcode=em20220422-other-1799&t=1021&refcode2=1799_346206_8CY9nX&akid=1799%2E346206%2E8CY9nX ]Peter,
when I defeat Rand Paul this year, I’ll
take action to address the climate crisis with housing justice, guaranteed
union jobs, and direct community investment. But I need your help to get
there — will you join us today by chipping in $5 today?

A Green New Deal is an integral part of our agenda to bring real,
progressive change to Kentucky and our country.

Kentucky is one of the largest coal-producing states in the country, and
our economy has been rocked by the decline of the coal industry. Other
states are in similar positions. We need to build an economy that thrives
on clean, renewable sources of energy — not one that depends on fossil
fuels.

This is a responsibility I don’t take lightly: We must build a future in
which my two young girls — and young people everywhere — can thrive.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220422?refcode=em20220422-other-1799&t=1022&refcode2=1799_346206_8CY9nX&akid=1799%2E346206%2E8CY9nX ]I know that I’m the one that’ll make the Green New Deal happen. But I
can’t get there without your help. Please if you want the Senate to take
on climate action, please chip in $5, $15, or whatever you can afford to
our movement today.

Onward,

Charles

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.charlesbooker.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1799%2E346206%2E8CY9nX

Even after a lifetime of living in Eastern Iowa, I still marvel at the natural beauty of our state – and today is a reminder that our shared home needs our help and care to thrive. [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44441686/341601248/1206856155?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTUxNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWYwYTY4YS03NGMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5AU_rfBVO-DlkoahpxF1GHect9TDJ6CoTMoUbJkztus=&emci=692d3745-55c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=45f0a68a-74c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=6566505) Our environment is changing and we must focus on our future generations who should be able to raise a family, farm the fields, and breathe the air without fear of worsening weather events and pollution. Iowa is already at the forefront of our clean energy transformation, and we must continue this focus over the coming decades – creating thousands of good-paying jobs right here in our own backyard along the way. name: Alessandra Biaggi
subject: Student debt forgiveness
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alessandra Biaggi for Congress
body:
#
Friends —
The Biden administration recently extended its moratorium on student loan repayment until August 31st. You’ll remember that the moratorium began at the beginning of the pandemic and has been extended several times since.
While I understand that the moratorium has afforded many the opportunity to stay afloat financially throughout the pandemic, the fact of the matter is that President Biden could provide immediate relief to millions of Americans by forgiving their debt.
**[Please, add your name if you agree that the President must cancel federal student loan debt.](https://act.alessandrabiaggi.com/signup/em220422-student-debt-survey/?source=em220422-1-15&akid=721%2E59515%2Eldc94K)**
**[SIGN ON](https://act.alessandrabiaggi.com/signup/em220422-student-debt-survey/?source=em220422-1-15&akid=721%2E59515%2Eldc94K)**
Millions of Americans are saddled with debt from higher education that often amounts to hundreds and thousands of dollars.
That includes many who never graduated from college — 40% of all people with student debt — and over 9 million Americans over 50 who were unable to pay off loans either for themselves or family members.
Having student loans often means being unable to save for a rainy day, build wealth, or retire. It’s bad for the economy, and it’s bad for people.
**[So I’m calling on the President to cancel federal student loan debt. Add your name here to join me.](https://act.alessandrabiaggi.com/signup/em220422-student-debt-survey/?source=em220422-1-15&akid=721%2E59515%2Eldc94K)**
**[SIGN ON](https://act.alessandrabiaggi.com/signup/em220422-student-debt-survey/?source=em220422-1-15&akid=721%2E59515%2Eldc94K)**
There’s so much more we can do for Americans seeking higher education, including limiting private universities’ ability to charge as much as they want in tuition.
But relieving individuals of their student debt is a move that the President can take immediately and unilaterally to offer relief to millions.
Thank you for reading,
Alessandra

Paid For By Alessandra Biaggi for Congress

This Earth Day, help us send a message to the White House.
#
Happy Earth Day! 🌍
**Today we’re coming to you with an important action item.** Our dependence on fossil fuel harms our environment and empowers authoritarians like Vladimir Putin, rogue oil-producing nations, and price-gouging oil companies. **For the sake of our national security and planet, we must call our leaders to take immediate action to invest in domestic clean energy jobs and end our dependence on fossil fuel.**
[**_If you agree, will you sign the petition to demand that our Democratic leaders say in one voice: America must lead on clean energy. End dependence on fossil fuels!_**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50083?t=1&akid=1117%2E3698%2EpjyWcZ) _Signatures will be delivered to the White House and allies in Congress._
**[Add your name »](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50083?t=2&akid=1117%2E3698%2EpjyWcZ)**
**Taking a moment to sign this petition is a way to create real change this Earth Day.** In addition to the national security and climate imperatives for ending our dependence on fossil fuels, the corporations that supply fossil fuels are using the tragedy in Ukraine to price-gouge Americans at the pump.
**Right now, in North Carolina and across the country, we’re paying more for gas, while Big Oil is raking in massive profits.** Bloomberg News reports that billionaire oil and gas CEOs increased their net worths by more than 10% since Russia invaded Ukraine last month — that’s over $24 billion!
Why? Corporate greed. Tycoons and the corporations they own shouldn't get rich off of human suffering. If we end our dependence on fossil fuel, they won’t.
[**_It’s time for a clean energy future that’ll create millions of good-paying jobs and secure energy freedom — that’s why Erica Smith is proud to join the Sierra Club, League of Conservation Voters, and others calling on our Democratic leaders to act. Will you add your name to join them?_**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/50083?t=3&akid=1117%2E3698%2EpjyWcZ)
— Team Erica Smith
Erica Smith is a single mother, educator, and three-term state senator, who grew up on her family farm and spent her life fighting for rural Eastern North Carolina. **\- Three Ways the American Rescue Plan Delivered for Hoosiers this Week -**
1. **Governor Holcomb Takes Credit for Broadband Projects Paid for by American Rescue Plan**
Governor Eric Holcomb and the Indiana Republican Party are once again trying to take credit for the accomplishments of President Joe Biden and Indiana Democrats. On Monday, Holcomb [touted a series of investments to expand broadband internet across Indiana](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44443452/341612151/-1651935166?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzFjZWZkOC03YmMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VN8Z3CbhrCIg1RuzjiYFTEPLNpAiG5Rj7FAAkMtjp2c=&emci=159d7d03-69c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=dc1cefd8-7bc2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535) – including about $190 million from the state.
**The problem: these investments were made possible by the[American Rescue Plan](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44443453/341612152/2075701864?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzFjZWZkOC03YmMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VN8Z3CbhrCIg1RuzjiYFTEPLNpAiG5Rj7FAAkMtjp2c=&emci=159d7d03-69c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=dc1cefd8-7bc2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535), not the Indiana GOP. Democrats delivered for Hoosiers, and we must correct this record at every possible opportunity.**

2. **American Rescue Plan Delivers $3.5 Million to Improve Services for Domestic Violence and Sexual Assault Survivors**
The COVID-19 relief law is [investing in services for domestic violence and sexual assault survivors across Indiana](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44443455/341612154/-1274939404?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzFjZWZkOC03YmMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VN8Z3CbhrCIg1RuzjiYFTEPLNpAiG5Rj7FAAkMtjp2c=&emci=159d7d03-69c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=dc1cefd8-7bc2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535). The Indiana Criminal Justice Institute awarded $3.5 million to nonprofits to provide remote services, emergency shelter, and related assistance to Hoosiers experiencing domestic abuse. According to the Indiana Coalition Against Domestic Violence, [intimate partner-related deaths in Indiana increased by 181%](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44443457/341612156/-721332994?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzFjZWZkOC03YmMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VN8Z3CbhrCIg1RuzjiYFTEPLNpAiG5Rj7FAAkMtjp2c=&emci=159d7d03-69c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=dc1cefd8-7bc2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535) during the pandemic. These investments by Indiana Democrats like André Carson and Frank Mrvan will help shelters improve their services for those affected by domestic violence and sexual assault throughout the state.

3. **American Rescue Plan Delivers “Transformational” $25 million to Bakers Corner**
Finally, the Rescue Plan [established new water and sewer utilities in unserved areas of northeast Hamilton County](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44443459/341612158/-611596661?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzFjZWZkOC03YmMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VN8Z3CbhrCIg1RuzjiYFTEPLNpAiG5Rj7FAAkMtjp2c=&emci=159d7d03-69c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=dc1cefd8-7bc2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535) with the goal of stimulating economic development. The $25 million investment will create new jobs and expand housing developments in Hamilton County.
While Republicans like County Commissioner Heirbrandt acknowledge the “transformational” investments made by the American Rescue Plan, politicians like U.S. Senator Todd Young voted “NO” on these investments, proving the Indiana GOP has no plans for our future – just partisanship.

**\- Tom McDermott, Indiana Democrats Launch Four Day Statewide Tour Calling for Cannabis Legalization -** This week, Indiana Democrats like Tom McDermott, Destiny Wells, and Ryan Mears joined Indiana NORML and Hoosier Veterans for Medical Cannabis for the launch of a four day, seven city statewide tour calling for the legalization of cannabis. The tour coincides with [a powerful video by McDermott](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44443461/341612160/474851188?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYzFjZWZkOC03YmMyLWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VN8Z3CbhrCIg1RuzjiYFTEPLNpAiG5Rj7FAAkMtjp2c=&emci=159d7d03-69c2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&emdi=dc1cefd8-7bc2-ec11-997e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4925535) where he described how marijuana is a central pillar for his U.S. Senate campaign. “We have seen the impact that recreational and medicinal cannabis use has made on the states around us, and not only are Hoosiers contributing to neighboring states’ economies, Indiana is now on the verge of losing out altogether,” **said Mike Schmuhl, Chairman of the Indiana Democratic Party.** “It’s unfortunate to see Indiana Republicans have no plan on cannabis, and instead, see them oppose this common sense policy due to partisanship. Democrats have taken the lead on this effort because it’s a win-win for the state’s economy and for Hoosiers altogether. body:
#

Happy Earth Day!
As you might guess, today I’m thinking about our planet, and what we can do to protect it for future generations.
Last year, I stood alongside Sen. Ed Markey, Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and other progressives in the House and Senate to re-introduce the Green New Deal.
Now, I’m asking you to join us and add your name as a citizen co-sponsor of the Green New Deal. **Please, use this link to show your support:**
[**https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/Green-New-Deal**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/Earth-Day-em-apr22/?source=em220422-1-30&refcode2=754.159979.7M7_M3&akid=754%2E159979%2E7M7_M3)
The unfortunate truth is that climate change is one of the single largest threats facing California, our nation, and the entire planet.
But the good news is we have the technology to tackle the climate crisis head-on while creating new good-paying union jobs and delivering justice for the people and communities already on the front lines of climate change.
_What we need now, more than anything else, is the political will to take bold action, to move away from our dependence on fossil fuels and towards renewable forms of energy like wind or solar._
**I signed on as a Co-sponsor on the Green New Deal because I understand that big problems like climate change require BIG solutions. But it will also require a BIG movement of people like you who are committed to protecting our planet for future generations.**
[**Please, add your name as a citizen co-sponsor of the Green New Deal and help me show my colleagues that this is a priority for people here in California and across the country.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/Earth-Day-em-apr22/?source=em220422-1-30&refcode2=754.159979.7M7_M3&akid=754%2E159979%2E7M7_M3)
Thank you, and enjoy the rest of your Earth Day!
All my best,
Alex Padilla

| | Acabamos de terminar el segundo trimestre de la campaña y tenemos un gran progreso para compartir. La recaudación de fondos para el primer trimestre batió récords, al igual que el segundo. ¡Recaudamos más dinero que cualquier otro retador demócrata en el estado y más dinero que cualquier retador republicano en el distrito cuatro del Congreso! La estructura de esta campaña y nuestro ambicioso plan de comunicación nos ha llevado más lejos, más rápido y con mayor éxito que otras campañas. Mi campaña está organizada para incluir a todos los presidentes de condados demócratas y distritos legislativos. Al hacerlo, aprovechamos de inmediato décadas de conocimiento y vastas redes de relaciones y recursos. Esto nos permitió empezar en un punto al que otras campañas no podían llegar en años, mucho menos en un ciclo electoral. We have just finished the second quarter of the campaign, and we have great progress to share. Fundraising for the first quarter was record breaking, and so was the second. We raised more money than any other democratic challenger in the state and more money than any republican challenger in congressional district four! The structure of this campaign and our ambitious outreach plan has moved us further, faster and with greater success than other campaigns. My campaign is organized to include all of the Democratic County and Legislative District chairs. In doing so we immediately tap into decades of knowledge and vast networks of relationships and resources. This allowed us to start at a point that other campaigns could not reach in years, much less an election cycle.
---
| |
---
|
---
| | Reconocí que el modelo electoral tradicional solo nos llevaría hasta cierto punto. No podemos ignorar la forma en que se hacen las cosas, pero la política tradicional carece de inclusión. Cuando pregunté cómo llegaríamos al 50% o más de mis electores que son hispanos, la respuesta anterior fue: “podemos traducir un volante al español”; eso no es inclusión. Incorporé al primer Defensor de la Diversidad pagado a tiempo completo para llegar a las comunidades que estaban privadas de sus derechos del proceso político y hacerles saber que en esta campaña hay espacio para todos. La respuesta ha sido abrumadoramente positiva. Me he fijado metas altas para esta campaña. Ya he estado desde la parte superior de este distrito hasta el fondo y de regreso 3 veces y cada semana nosotros:
* celebrar un ayuntamiento
* Trabajar para llamar a 50.000 puertas antes de julio
* Banco de teléfono dos veces
* celebrar un evento
* Participar en más de 5 eventos realizados o patrocinados por otras organizaciones
* ¡Y solo estamos empezando!

Comenzaremos a vender letreros de jardín la próxima semana @ [www.DougWhite4Congress.us](https://www.dougwhite4congress.us/so/74O1IIjaU/c?w=4HYr9RNtm9Y-ZHMHfNbPBLR2dulCW2c17F1ptRxrZ9k.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cDovL2RvdWd3aGl0ZTRjb25ncmVzcy51cyIsInIiOiJmNzZjZjEwNS02MTIzLTQzN2ItNzg5MS1jMzQyMWViZGQ4ZjAiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIwNDk2ZmZlMC1jMGJhLTQ2MDYtOTk4Ni1jMjgwMzdlOGQxNTUifQ) La campaña también ha estado trabajando para traducir completamente toda nuestra literatura, incluido nuestro sitio web, al español. ¡Asegúrese de visitar el sitio web el 1 de mayo para ver la versión completamente en español, y mientras esté allí, puede reservar su letrero de jardín! La votación también tendrá lugar a finales de mayo. Estamos aumentando nuestros viajes, recaudación de fondos y alcance comunitario, con planes de llegar a tres veces más personas en junio que en abril.
---
| | I recognized that the traditional election model would only get us so far. We cannot ignore the way things are done, but traditional politics lack inclusion. When I asked how we would reach the 50+% of my constituents that are Hispanic the old answer was, “we can translate a flier into Spanish”; that is not inclusion. I brought on board the first full time paid Diversity Advocate to reach out to communities that were disenfranchised from the political process and let them know there is room in this campaign for everyone. The response has been overwhelmingly positive.I have set high goals for this campaign. I have already been from the top of this district to the bottom and back again 3 times already and every week we:
* Hold a Town Hall
* Work towards knocking on 50,000 doors before July
* Phone bank twice
* Hold one event
* Participate in more than 5 events held or sponsored by other organizations
* And we are just getting started!

We will start selling yard signs next week @ [www.DougWhite4Congress.us](https://www.dougwhite4congress.us/so/74O1IIjaU/c?w=vVdAaVgbZEVeeNbjTskCufIuCVITk6dGuR-q8rVCFPk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cDovL3d3dy5kb3Vnd2hpdGU0Y29uZ3Jlc3MudXMiLCJyIjoiZjM0M2E0NzQtODVhMS00YjZiLTQwYzQtOWZlZTc5ZjI3ZDIyIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMDQ5NmZmZTAtYzBiYS00NjA2LTk5ODYtYzI4MDM3ZThkMTU1In0) The campaign has also been working to fully translate all of our literature, including our website, into Spanish. Be sure to check out the website on May 1st to see the fully Spanish version, and while you’re there you can reserve your yard sign! Polling will also take place in late May. We are ramping up our travel, fundraising and community outreach, with plans to reach three times as many people in June as we did in April.
---
| |
---
| Doug celebra "el tomar democráticamente" en Goldendale. Doug celebrates "Drinking Democratically" in Goldendale.
---
| |
---
| | Nuestro trabajo por la diversidad también ha crecido. Estamos planeando eventos que incluirán comida y cuidado de niños, para poder llegar a las familias jóvenes. Hemos establecido relaciones con organizaciones locales en varios condados, lo que triplica la cantidad de alcance que podemos lograr. Esto amplifica el trabajo que ya se está haciendo por la justicia social y ambiental. Estamos trabajando de cerca con un grupo de jóvenes latinos locales para continuar expandiendo nuestra red de base en Tri-Cities a través de diarios, medios, radio/podcast y música y arte. Estamos trabajando en estrecha colaboración con los miembros de las tribus Colville y Yakama para establecer una relación duradera con las comunidades indígenas. Esperamos asistir a nuestros primeros pow-wows y otros eventos importantes. Our work towards diversity has also grown. We are planning events that will include food and childcare, so that we can reach out to young families. We have established relationships with local organizations in several counties, which triples the amount of outreach we are able to achieve. This amplifies work already being done for social and environmental justice. We are working closely with a group of local young Latinos to continue to expand our grassroots network in Tri-Cities through journaling, media, radio/podcast and music and art. We are working closely with Colville and Yakama tribe members to establish a long-standing relationship with indigenous communities. We look forward to attending our first pow-wows and other significant events.
---
| |
---
|
---
| | La semana pasada también asistimos al foro de reforma de inmigración y H2A organizado por el caucus agrícola y rural. El programa H2A está lejos de ser perfecto y necesita más responsabilidad y recursos para hacer cumplir las regulaciones. Es bueno estar en discusión entre productores y trabajadores agrícolas a través de UFW. Asistí a la experiencia En Sus Zapatos que busca dar una mirada al interior desde la perspectiva de las víctimas de violencia doméstica. La violencia doméstica es una de las principales causas de violencia en nuestras comunidades y debe abordarse directamente. In the past week we also attended the H2A and Immigration reform forum hosted by the Ag and Rural caucus. The H2A program is far from perfect and it needs more accountability and resources to enforce regulations. It is good to be in discussion between growers and farmworkers via UFW. I attended the In Her Shoes experience aimed at giving an inside look from the perspective of domestic violence victims. Domestic violence is one of the leading causes of violence in our communities, and needs to be directly addressed.
---
| |
---
| | ¡Cómo ganamos! Los fundamentos de esta carrera cambiaron significativamente en los últimos meses, lo que hizo que nuestro camino hacia la victoria fuera más claro. Todos los indicios continúan apuntando a que Dan Newhouse no sobrevivirá a la primaria. Los indicadores incluyen una reprimenda completa por parte de los republicanos estatales y distritales y su recaudación de fondos se ha desplomado. Loren Culp esperaba un impulso a su campaña con el respaldo de Donald Trump, pero eso no produjo ningún dinero. Hasta ahora su única notoriedad ha venido de su inexcusable y grosero comportamiento. El Partido Republicano se dividió cuando los republicanos del distrito le dieron la espalda a Donald Trump y apoyaron a Brad Klippert. Newhouse no tiene garantizados los votos para ganar las primarias. Pero incluso con esa realidad, el resto de los republicanos no pueden actuar juntos para formar una campaña o gestionar la comunicación con los votantes. ¡La mitad de ellos ya están endeudados! Quizás para asegurarme de enfrentarme a Culp en las primarias, que es el mejor escenario para mi victoria, tendría que prestarle algo de dinero y hacer campaña por él. How we win! The fundamentals of this race changed significantly over the last few months making our path to victory clearer. All indications continue to point to Dan Newhouse not surviving the primary. Indicators include a complete rebuke by the state and district republicans and his fundraising has plummeted. Loren Culp expected a boost to his campaign with Donald Trump’s endorsement, but that did not translate into any money. So far his only notoriety has come from his inexcusable and loutish behavior. The GOP split when the district republicans turned their back on Donald Trump and endorsed Brad Klippert. Newhouse isn’t guaranteed the votes to win the primary. But even with that reality, the rest of the republicans can not get their act together to form a campaign or manage outreach. Half of them are in debt already! Perhaps to ensure I will face Culp in the primary, which is the best scenario for my victory, I would have to loan him some money and do some campaigning for him.

My campaign is grateful for the coalition we are building, and the work that is getting done. I look forward to continuing to update you on our path to victory.

body:
Join us TOMORROW for the state GOP convention! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a8c444ddf883/i-cant-believe-its-finally-here?e=10c1db3257)
---
| | [ ](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=a97620f4a8&e=10c1db3257)
---
|
---
| Friend,

After weeks of planning and anticipation, **the day has finally come! **

The state Republican convention is **TOMORROW, April 23rd,** and I want to invite you to join us at **Utah's best 'big tent party' of the year!** The convention is **open to the public, free to attend, and guaranteed to be a day of fun! **

**If you were elected as a delegate this year, congratulations!** Your efforts as a delegate are the**backbone of our convention system.** Your dedication does not go unnoticed;******thank you. **

**If you are not attending as a delegate,** I hope you'll take this opportunity to **meet local candidates** and **discover new ways to engage** with our political system.

Whether you are attending as a delegate or an engaged voter, **I'm eager to meet you and discuss the issues that matter most** to you!

**Make sure to view the [convention agenda](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=2149266cc1&e=10c1db3257) and our [booth map](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=e34616d8e7&e=10c1db3257) ahead of your arrival at the Mountain America Expo Center, [9575 State St, Sandy, UT 84070](https://beckyforutah.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb6d6dad27d2e4a00e5c44525&id=175526c250&e=10c1db3257). Credentialing for delegates begins at 7:00 AM sharp, and the convention welcome will start at 10:30 AM. **

I am thrilled to finally share the hard work Team Becky has dedicated to **making this convention a hit.** We will be at Saturday's convention ALL DAY! **Join us at our Becky Booth party on the northeast end of the convention hall, booths 10 and 11.** Our delegate campaign rally will begin at **10:00 AM. **We'll have **Becky swag, a polaroid booth, and a fantastic team** ready** ** to help make your convention day a success.
---
| | **Looking for more ways to have a great convention?
Here are a few things to know: **
* Talk to each candidate you can find! Candidates from all corners of the state will be attending, ready to talk to YOU about the issues that matter most.
* Outside food will not be allowed in the expo center. Bring a few bucks for snacks at the concessions booth, or join us outside the expo center for sandwiches at the TeamBecky van.
* Bring a water bottle and stay hydrated.
* Carry an extra wall or portable charger.
* Collect swag! Booths convention-wide will have all kinds of swag for you to take home.
* Be ready to listen, share, and engage! The convention is an opportunity for you to ask important questions and learn about your candidate's goals.
* Wear comfortable shoes so you can take advantage of all the convention's events and activities.

| | | Hey there,

I wanted to make sure you had a chance to see this invitation to help Mike get on the ballot. Meet us **TOMORROW at Inclusion Coffee Company in Hartland or at Fiddleheads Coffee in Menomonee Falls.**

It is critical that Mike gets 2,000 signatures and the clock is ticking. Please join to help us secure Mike’s place on the ballot.
---
|
---
| **Saturday, 04/23 9-11AM**
_Inclusion Coffee Company_
3152 Village Square Dr
Hartland, WI 53029

**Saturday, 04/23 12-1PM**
_Fiddleheads Coffee_
N88 W16621, Appleton Ave
Menomonee Falls, WI 53051
This is a simple and fast process that goes a long way to help the campaign. If you live in the 5th district, take some tomorrow and swing by for some coffee and to get Mike on the ballot.

See you then,

Team Mike Van Someren

| Hi there,

Thank you to everyone who has helped to circulate my nomination papers so far. We’ve got about a month and some change to secure the 2,000 signatures necessary to appear on the ballot this fall, and we’re making some headway.

**If you’re out and about this weekend and haven’t signed yet, you can help by swinging by Inclusion Coffee Company in Hartland, or Fiddleheads Coffee in Menomonee Falls to sign my nomination papers.** It only takes a few moments and is a meaningful, easy way to help my campaign #Flipthe5th.
---
|
---
| **Saturday, 04/23 9-11AM**
_Inclusion Coffee Company_
3152 Village Square Dr
Hartland, WI 53029

**Saturday, 04/23 12-1PM**
_Fiddleheads Coffee_
N88 W16621, Appleton Ave
Menomonee Falls, WI 53051
**If you reside in the 5th district and are eligible to register to vote, come grab a coffee this Saturday at Inclusion or Fiddleheads and help me gain ballot access.**

If you can’t make it and still want to help, you can always visit [MikeVanSomeren.com/nominate-mike](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=5e0c34a246&e=356c0699dd) to download, circulate and/or sign papers of your own! Even if it’s just your name, be sure to sign the bottom as a circulator and return them to my team as soon as possible. [Full instructions can be found here.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=7333f7176e&e=356c0699dd)

Your support means the world to me. See you this weekend!

Thank you,
Mike Van Someren

body:
No other candidate on that stage has what John has.
#
Hi Derek.
It’s Joe Calvello, John Fetterman’s Director of Communications.
This is actually my first time writing an email to you. But after last night’s debate, I decided it was time to reach out personally.
Here are a few takeaways:
**Last night, John Fetterman not only showed why he’s running away with this primary, but why he’s the Democrat with the best chance of flipping this seat in November.**
John said it best on that stage — we gotta get real about what we’re up against this cycle.
The Democrat who runs for this seat in the general needs to be a candidate who has truly embraced the 67 County strategy and can put up the margins we need in Pennsylvania’s smaller or red counties.
We also need a candidate who has built an unparalleled grassroots movement, so we have the resources to go up against the GOP. Spoiler alert, that’s John.
Now let’s talk for just a second about how John’s opponents tried and failed to tear him down last night with a ton of bullsh*t.
Just like he’s been doing for months, Conor Lamb tried to attack John with Republican talking points. Unsurprisingly, they fell totally flat.
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47428?amount=5&refcode=em20220422-5494&t=1&akid=5494%2E434096%2EaKrXjX)
**The bottom line is that John Fetterman walked onto the stage tonight with a commanding lead, and he left the stage with a commanding lead.**
He’s honest, he’s authentic, and he talks like an actual person. And frankly, conventional political labels don’t stick to him.
**[Last night’s debate made it crystal clear. We’re on the track to flip Pennsylvania’s open U.S. Senate seat as long as we keep our momentum going strong. Can you make your first $5 donation to help John secure the Democratic nomination once and for all on May 17?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47428?amount=5&refcode=em20220422-5494&t=2&akid=5494%2E434096%2EaKrXjX)**
**[Contribute $5 »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47428?amount=5&refcode=em20220422-5494&t=21&akid=5494%2E434096%2EaKrXjX)**
Your support means so much to John, especially in big moments like these. Let’s win this thing.
Thanks,
Joe Calvello
Director of Communications
Fetterman for PA
[@the_vello](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/47436?t=22&akid=5494%2E434096%2EaKrXjX)

The latest news from the Republican Party of Wisconsin
