### April 22, 2022
Friend -- We hope you are excited for our 2022 State Convention! Here at the WisGOP, we have been busy preparing for the annual event, in Middleton this year, while ramping up our ground game efforts ahead of crucial elections in November. If you would like to attend the convention on May 20-22, you can still register [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=uuUyPGiVHWR_V3cUbcvCWRj2cMYkWVNJAvLz3dukgRI03s73cUlMp_-JMdenwImXcHmlm-nVIxFEoI4O3fslo-1WSz75GgaYgoPU4QX3CQWL2c-S7f4yo-9hgM15FKeh8wr_0BkIiHsfIq8nTdSeQg&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_4_22_22&n=2) , or sign up [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0eXv_5DaexUSZI9PlfXgIO8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_4_22_22&n=3) to join us by becoming a volunteer at the local level. Take a look at what we’re working on at the Republican Party of Wisconsin below. As always, thanks for all you do! \- Team WisGOP | We are less than 30 days out from our WisGOP State Convention in Middleton on May 20-22! There is still time to register for an action-packed weekend, where attendees will be able to hear from leaders in the conservative movement, get to know candidates for statewide office and elected officials, and help us prepare ahead of November. Visit our convention website [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=uuUyPGiVHWR_V3cUbcvCWRj2cMYkWVNJAvLz3dukgRI03s73cUlMp_-JMdenwImXcHmlm-nVIxFEoI4O3fslo-1WSz75GgaYgoPU4QX3CQWL2c-S7f4yo-9hgM15FKeh8wr_0BkIiHsfIq8nTdSeQg&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=newsletter_4_22_22&n=4) to sign up before it’s too late! This Earth Day, Democrats have used the holiday to remind Wisconsinites of their accomplishments for the environment – or lack thereof. Democrat candidate for U.S. Senate Mandela Barnes claims to be an expert on environmental issues because he chairs Tony Evers’ Climate Change Task Force. However, when asked if any of his “55 concrete strategies” for addressing climate change in Wisconsin had been successfully implemented, Barnes could not name one. Conversely, under President Trump, Republicans proved that protecting our earth doesn’t have to come at the expense of our economic growth. Here are just a few ways we’ve seen the impacts of climate change in Arizona: 1. There have been record summer temperatures and drought. 2. Communities in Arizona and our district are already starting to feel the water crunch. 3. Catastrophic wildfires have been wreaking havoc across the state. We can’t elect politicians who ignore the threat of climate change on our future and our present. This is why I plan to make climate change mitigation and our environment a priority when I am in Congress. = | = Climate change is not a singular issue - it is a universal issue. Our response to climate change must be reflected in every policy of the federal government. **Draining The Swamp 🐊
**
There’s only one way to drain the swamp in Washington: Term limits.

Our Founding Fathers never intended for our system of government to be run by career politicians who know the lobbyists’ interests better than their own constituents. The way I see it, limits on government power and fresh blood in Washington is always a good thing.

I’m a big believer in term limits and am proud to [sponsor legislation](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=041adf49760d4de79ab80090a9fca5d6&_e=MFJIkw37hYnNxYuqUCRKIDg07bNVQcyFGv36mlmRfGrIVqOb3WjAIIMM79qD15kSxg-RK_-tUkrsdoxFYNLRUANcmZczezUtBfCzVrojmTyudWRYJWDXZhUzU6HIPqIwcoOldjGdvIZvkQGskyYefqlP65vrqIQqPW1sMU1chzoV5Xj-PAvFCxnkXbLzhsjICD6GyBr__EKaZm6r7f0o7qC5pz9TpdTjhQLum7TNbTSxtY7xnsHgb8IS7VYsNVLcmh1SAabaBeF-mdogixSfnkPPMtr8XcYsTmIlw67dBJKWEhNajmmJLKkVG9GAEADUdsjO6cge91NYsw-RBtsqpldcr1f6RRcqZtDjIxwYCFzW8dxIk1kf24vaaPMy1aj3nMRda-GM2VW2mvO71D7-plEGDaNqSlDM-pZpsC_sGNChz7vdQWfByamk0GlAAW-kI97FUddNu9z_VDWW2mrzfQ%3D%3D) to impose term limits on members of Congress. But there’s more we can do. This week, I backed a proposal to add [term limits](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=041adf49760d4de79ab80090a9fca5d6&_e=MFJIkw37hYnNxYuqUCRKICPE-1REcsRf_tsozdbWoiH2XYdeGEB-nGVsfUR4joioDn23ogF5k-HArOci6xmYjj5TckZ04YCC6BBd-w5-DmBpwCOA9dyu6HCqpCPHyL5ZUtQgBu99j3cylqZzlSYrfy_QOhFjQOYNL7lAzgQH7k1-Vx9pTt0oZ8Q68glVBegYpM-2lxNIwX89ir_3OAWabwWAaVkpN7PxVePyFsxUdIyA5XKRarsFdeRXFhBV2GQP0RNg0NPyZ9McmU2rIg_WkGH1SgjpavqgNlot5DJsPEJAU91kWCTK9CnyuI1ypofySbF-8NFdGYUk9xu9sIzbF4YvuQ5Ealua0n3CATWgN_fqHp7NXrhoCZ35tsaCkBtY) for congressional committee chairs and ranking members to House rules.

Why?

Because I was raised on the basic principle of choosing the best person for the job—not just giving the top slots to the person who has been in Congress the longest.

Republicans have long had a rule prohibiting members from serving more than [three consecutive terms](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=041adf49760d4de79ab80090a9fca5d6&_e=MFJIkw37hYnNxYuqUCRKIBn4ZTS65kywhTIYj4w4RMHEp-2Ovf9O3CoiU9Eq70ov3nIySdkMTqt2PpEL2VJed_qdmORLfVO58juCEfLEjuUF6dIanKoeXn9PwrxVyMrcaxB7CQRwj7FovPvDQR3tc9GKbziNj1vPBbgc-f4LdvnS5aegEqeJ_Eiry2F6TcCQM0b_UGR89ia7nUI75JBdJJvJftu1lKsm0IoPdGVihLa3nCuZdOY1pw33DXkUF7ywUH6rfYYijhcrCsaMTIPPQiyj8GcX07tsCaVzPt0MPL166dYChiuF0UwFO6TAPeZGkadbFvOJmesidaM4tBYuauzHOcO0s6YsVOzuXbRTq-0XWwPcwgO64atjbK2MoOEw) as a ranking member or chair of a committee, but the Democrats have no such restraint. Rather, they pass the reins off to whichever members have been in Washington the [longest](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=041adf49760d4de79ab80090a9fca5d6&_e=MFJIkw37hYnNxYuqUCRKIEcNgYKzEuR974jzXOW-HUj-NDrPth_YHrn2tc_axLHGW9w7GFzCghzzeyF52ES4T-tVVvwOICisyPIO7oayEereS_8E0I-MNrfu62iXzNcKWSH9oAARi9ouufEhNVybAuQjXR90fKFdtSQD9ccBGDzhvIG5NxMODvcun4F_iNl7TDuf-sjiqdYULU0kF-YubKpqQexhDK745Xso6CPR2pDbF6WUm2A7OyJQMGRAMA2MDmkIU7kicDw6R89mg_Zwm2XtdGekKB86MXDA8vt2YRmSt0PtE5rZwq3OIANXimdum7tDRV14uKCtJeQM0iuYFdwEUpd5BW19u6OU40ncCxc%3D).

Typical D.C. swamp creature behavior, if you ask me.

Time to drain the swamp!

Our Founding Fathers never intended for our system of government to be run by career politicians who know the lobbyists’ interests better than their own constituents. The way I see it, limits on government power and fresh blood in Washington is always a good thing. I’m a big believer in term limits and am proud to to impose term limits on members of Congress. But there’s more we can do. This week, I backed a proposal to add for congressional committee chairs and ranking members to House rules. Why? Because I was raised on the basic principle of choosing the best person for the job—not just giving the top slots to the person who has been in Congress the longest. Republicans have long had a rule prohibiting members from serving more than as a ranking member or chair of a committee, but the Democrats have no such restraint. Rather, they pass the reins off to whichever members have been in Washington the . Typical D.C. swamp creature behavior, if you ask me. Fellow American,

I have to admit - I hadn't heard of the far-left publication called _The Nation_ before last week. Now, I'll never forget it.

They published an attack piece against me - based on the color of my skin - that is beyond ridiculous and insulting.

While I'm personally very offended, I'm genuinely sad for the author of this political hit piece.

There are a lot of nasty things said about me in this article simply because I'm a Black Republican. Like this:

"Herschel Walker, the football star turned Georgia Senate candidate, is an animated caricature of a Black person drawn by white conservatives."
Or maybe this line:

"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."
It's shameful.

But the writer doesn't just take aim at me. He questions the support from folks like you, too:

"Most white people in the South vote 'R' like their entire white supremacist project depends on it."
Fellow American, I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign. However, can you imagine the reaction from the mainstream media if these things had been said about a Black Democrat? The outrage! There would be calls for the writer to be fired and the publication cancelled.

But I'm not calling for a protest of the author or a boycott of the publication's advertisers. Nothing like that.

_**I think the best answer is to prove them wrong at the ballot box.**_

Peter, we have some exciting news to share.

John is launching a tour around the district — to all 29 counties — that we’re calling his "Boots on the Ground" tour.

So, why Boots on the Ground? Since raising his hand to serve, John is always ready to lace up his boots and fight for what matters — from combat in Iraq, to helping his fellow veterans transition, to serving at the forefront of national service legislation on Capitol Hill.
Now he’s ready to grab his boots again and hit every part of the district to serve and represent all the different communities and constituents in TX-23.

Traveling across a district this large is not cheap, so we’re counting on you and your support to make it happen. Will you chip in $29 so we can make sure John visits every county in the district?

As one of the largest districts in terms of land and a majority rural, making sure we can stop and spend plenty of time in each county is no small feat — but this campaign has never been one to avoid hard work and we know that making sure people across TX-23 are heard is worth it.

Will you contribute $29 now so that John can put boots on the ground in all 29 counties of TX-23? Let’s make sure we can hear out as many people as possible up and down the border.

subject: We’re celebrating 60 Green New Deal wins today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Time and time again our movement has proved that people power can beat even the most entrenched special interests and policy makers in Congress — and that includes Big Oil.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220422-2969-header&t=1&akid=2969%2E2526796%2EJrqNSC)
**This Earth Day, we are celebrating the certification of 60 community projects Alexandria helped win funding for** that meet the Green New Deal’s standards for green jobs, environmental justice, and decarbonization.
From Hawaii to Vermont, these GND-certified community projects include jobs and training programs in sustainable building, rail expansion, bike infrastructure, trail infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, and more.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220422?refcode=em20220422-2969-P_FND_ANO_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2969_2526796_JrqNSC&akid=2969%2E2526796%2EJrqNSC)
**These community programs are one important way we’re working on the ground to build a greener future. But in Washington, our movement for a greener world is up against the most politically entrenched, well-funded industry on the planet: Big Oil.**
So if we’re going to make legislative gains in the fight against the ticking bomb that is the climate crisis, we need to come together this Earth Day and every day. And that’s why we’re asking you to make a $3 contribution right now to our movement.
[A $3 contribution from you today would send a powerful message to the oil industry that Americans — from your state and across the country — are united in the fight for a fossil-free future. Can we count on your $3 contribution today to help Alexandria take on Big Oil and pass the Green New Deal?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220422?refcode=em20220422-2969-P_FND_ANO_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&refcode2=2969_2526796_JrqNSC&akid=2969%2E2526796%2EJrqNSC)
**[Contribute $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220422?refcode=em20220422-2969-P_FND_ANO_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&refcode2=2969_2526796_JrqNSC&akid=2969%2E2526796%2EJrqNSC)**
When people say that we can’t or something is too hard or too expensive, we say, “watch us work” – and these Green New Deal community projects are a testament to that. We are dedicated to finding creative ways to fight the climate crisis, and secure jobs and environmental justice for our communities.
Time and time again our movement has proved that people power can beat even the most entrenched special interests and policy makers in Congress — and that includes Big Oil. [Make your $3 Earth Day contribution today to help Alexandria and our movement fight for the fossil-free world we need.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220422?refcode=em20220422-2969-P_FND_ANO_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&refcode2=2969_2526796_JrqNSC&akid=2969%2E2526796%2EJrqNSC)

Team AOC

subject: pants on fire
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Country First
body:
| [ ](http://www.country1st.com/?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=investment_nd&n=1)
---
Friend -- One of the frustrating things about working with liars is they have _zero_ trouble doubling down when confronted with the truth. And while the current news cycle presents a perfect example of this in Republican Leader Kevin McCarthy, I'm talking more about the loudest voices pushing Donald Trump's conspiracies and lies: Reps. Marjorie Taylor Greene, Madison Cawthorn, Lauren Boebert, and Matt Gaetz. These leaders are disastrous for America and Congress because they epitomize the toxic tribalism and partisan extremism that's tearing down our institutions and tearing apart our country. They'd rather chase fame than solve problems -- which wouldn't be so bad if they weren't undermining our republic in the process. **And that's why I'm announcing a huge investment in unseating these most toxic members of Congress _in the primary elections_.** | [](https://www.country1st.com/primaryfirst?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=investment_nd&n=2 "OUR PRIMARY TARGETS") [OUR PRIMARY TARGETS](https://www.country1st.com/primaryfirst?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=investment_nd&n=2)
---
[](https://www.country1st.com/primaryfirst?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=investment_nd&n=3)
Conventional wisdom would tell you that these incumbents can't be defeated in safe Republican districts... and if we were using the typical playbook, that'd be true. But our bold, first-of-its-kind strategy is to activate Democrats, Independents, and Disaffected Republicans to show up and vote them out IN THE PRIMARY. After all, so few Americans vote in the primaries that a small shift can have a HUGE impact on the outcome.
We've done the math and this can work, but we must have the resources to blanket these districts with direct mail, text messaging, ads, and grassroots outreach. Our plan is in place, and we're ready to execute it. **There's two ways you can help** (no matter where in the U.S. you live):
[](https://www.country1st.com/primaryfirst?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=investment_nd&n=4 "1\) Help Fund our Primary First Strategy") [1) Help Fund our Primary First Strategy](https://www.country1st.com/primaryfirst?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=investment_nd&n=4)
---
[](https://www.country1st.com/get_involved?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=investment_nd&n=5 "2\) Become a Primary First Volunteer") [2) Become a Primary First Volunteer](https://www.country1st.com/get_involved?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=investment_nd&n=5)
---
We have a strong foundation in place, and there's a lot of great work yet to be done! Thank you to everyone who has lent support of any kind (moral, financial, or both) to this cause. I know our kids and grandkids will thank us one day for refusing to accept today's politics as the new normal.
And finally, on a different note, I want to share an update on our movement's support of the Ukrainian people. Thanks to the generosity of our members, Country First has donated $50,000 to Nova Ukraine, $25,000 to the Ukraine Freedom Project, and earlier this week $15,000 to **[Ripley's Heroes](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=DN8SCKmgQCbOH7MF8cbxEzc9_ezEBTENPnSgyIHxTlsAZjw5quaTT_MRVGnhwvQm&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=investment_nd&n=6)**. Beyond support of refugees, the funds are also being used to purchase an ambulance, body armor, and aerial surveillance equipment.
Country First takes pride in identifying groups in Ukraine that are daring to work miracles, yet are not part of a major, well-heeled organization. We will continue looking for opportunities to help the Ukrainian people and I'll always give credit where it's due: the incredible Americans who bring this movement to life. Thank you!
Country First,

Adam

| | Peter, Happy Earth Day! It’s a very exciting day on Team Levin. Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez recognized original cosponsors of the Green New Deal who brought resources home that encapsulate the core pillars of the Green New Deal: Jobs, Justice, and Decarbonization. She announced that Andy Levin secured over $6 million dollars through community funding projects to Michigan that lay the foundation of the Green New Deal. When Andy met with community leaders to advocate for federal funding, he heard what the impacts of climate change and disinvestments in low-income communities were costing our families. Because of Andy’s advocacy, millions of dollars are now coming to Michigan to stop stormwater flooding, mitigate pollution and rising temperatures, and clean up our lakes, rivers, and drinking water! This is a great start – and we’re clear-eyed that there is still a lot more work to do. clean_body: A Green New Deal is here! | | | | | Peter, Happy Earth Day! It’s a very exciting day on Team Levin. Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez recognized original cosponsors of the Green New Deal who brought resources home that encapsulate the core pillars of the Green New Deal: Jobs, Justice, and Decarbonization. She announced that Andy Levin secured over $6 million dollars through community funding projects to Michigan that lay the foundation of the Green New Deal. When Andy met with community leaders to advocate for federal funding, he heard what the impacts of climate change and disinvestments in low-income communities were costing our families. Because of Andy’s advocacy, millions of dollars are now coming to Michigan to stop stormwater flooding, mitigate pollution and rising temperatures, and clean up our lakes, rivers, and drinking water! This is a great start – and we’re clear-eyed that there is still a lot more work to do.
